Text: えへへへ……

English.Text: Heh heh!

Text: 海岸にイルカがいるのよ　可愛いわ

English.Text: I love watching that dolphin splash around in the cove. He's so cute.

Text:
今日はたくさん　お魚がとれたの
明日もとれるようにお祈りしなくちゃ

English.Text: Not every day we bring in this many fish! Hope tomorrow's haul is just as good.

Text: ジュノンの豊かな海を取り戻そう！

English.Text: These seas belong to us─to Junon!

Text:
大志ある若者よ　サイドジュノン
反神羅青年団に来たれ！

English.Text: If you're sick of polluted waters and steel skies, then come to the Crow's Nest and join the cause!

Text: くう～　熱いよなオレたち！

English.Text: Goddamn, I get so fired up about this shit!

Text:
でもちょっと曲がってない？
貼り直し！

English.Text: Yeah, that's great and all, but the poster's still crooked!

Text: えっ　これでどうだ？

English.Text: For real? This any better?

Text:
『安全第一　コンドル予報』
これで何号だっけ

English.Text: How many issues of Clear Skies is this now? I kinda forgot.

Text:
忘れちゃったけど
それだけコンドル被害も減って
平和ってことよ

English.Text: But...that's a good thing, right? It means everyone's been giving the condor the space it needs!

Text:
干物を使った新メニュー
なにかないかしら

English.Text: Only so many ways you can prepare fish, and I'm running out of ideas...

Text:
うんうん　みんなの安全のために
コンドルの観察を続けよう！

English.Text: Very true. The more we respect the condor, the more it will respect us!

Text:
『安全第一　コンドル予報』
この写真　ちょっといいね

English.Text: Take a look at the new photo we got for Clear Skies. Pretty cute, don'tcha think?

Text: うん　楽しそう

English.Text: Yeah, it's a good one!

Text:
コンドルとも
いつか仲良くなれるといいよね

English.Text: Gives me hope that the condor'll learn to trust us one day.

Text:
うんうん
コンドルとわかりあえるように
観察を続けよう！

English.Text: Me too. And so long as we keep doing what we're doing, I know we'll win it over!

Text: ねえ　上でなにかあるんでしょ？

English.Text: So...what's happening topside?

Text:
神羅が派手なイベントをやるらしい
オレたちもどうにか潜り込まなきゃな

English.Text: A Shinra event─one they're pullin' out all the stops for. We gotta get up there to see it.

Text:
でも　エレベーターには近づけないよ
コンドルにでも運んでもらうっての？

English.Text: And how do you propose we do that? Hitch a ride on the condor?

Text: 上の騒ぎ　新社長就任式典だってな

English.Text: The inauguration parade is gonna be a real spectacle.

Text:
そこで神羅の次の方針を
打ち出すんだとさ

English.Text: I hear he's gonna announce some big policy changes too.

Text:
そっか　ルーファウスさんならいいかも
かっこいいし　清潔感あるし

English.Text: Rufus, huh...? Yeah, it'll be nice to have someone in charge who isn't a gargoyle.

Text:
オレたちの想いを
どうにか届けたいな

English.Text: Be nice to have someone who might listen to us.

Text: ここの海の底には　魔晄炉があるんだ

English.Text: We should've never let them build a reactor in our waters...

Text:
現状を知ったら変えてくれるかも
手紙に書いて送ろうよ

English.Text: Why don't we try writing him a strongly worded letter!

Text:
ルーファウスさんへの手紙
返事あったか？

English.Text: Any response to the letters we sent yet?

Text: もう９４通　まだ返事ないの

English.Text: Ninety-four written...and not one reply.

Text:
なんてったって　神羅の社長だ
きっと忙しいんだろ

English.Text: There's still a chance. Guy's prob'ly up to his eyeballs in work right now.

Text: 気長に待とうぜ

English.Text: Just be patient.

Text:
プリシラには会ったかい？
目立つ子だからすぐにわかるよ

English.Text: Have you met Priscilla yet? You'll know her when you see her. She's such a special girl.

Text:
とってもかわいくて　かしこくてね
イルカもよ～くなついてる

English.Text: Cute as a button and clever to boot. It's no wonder that dolphin has taken a liking to her.

Text:
プリシラはイルカに
芸を教えているんだよ

English.Text: Priscilla's even managed to teach her dolphin some tricks.

Text: アンダージュノン自慢の娘っ子さ

English.Text: She's our town's pride and joy, I tell you.

Text:
プリシラは　かわいいだろ
あたしの若い頃にそっくりなんだ

English.Text: Isn't Priscilla just adorable? She's the spitting image of me in my younger days.

Text:
イルカのことを話すと
止まらなくなるんだ

English.Text: If you get her going about dolphins, she'll talk your ear off.

Text: そこがまた　かわいいんだよ

English.Text: I adore that passion of hers.

Text:
プリシラのイルカショーを見るのが
楽しみで　長生きしてるよ

English.Text: I hope I live long enough to see Priscilla put on her very own dolphin show.

Text: 神羅は　やりたい放題やりやがる

English.Text: Shinra acts like they run the whole damn world...

Text:
チョコボ運送は制限　自由な漁業の禁止
どこも禁止に制限ばっかだ

English.Text: Clampin' down on chocobo deliveries, prohibiting us from fishing... What next? They gonna outlaw breathin'?

Text: 海は魔晄で汚し　空は都市で覆う

English.Text: Those corporate bastards may think they own the seas and the skies...

Text:
もともとここは
俺たちの土地なんだぞ　くそ

English.Text: but they're never gonna own us. That's for damn sure!

Text:
海がいつもと違うな　波が静かだ
こんな日はなにかあるぜ

English.Text: Ocean's real quiet today. Too quiet... Something's brewin', can tell ya that much...

Text:
海に出るなら気をつけろ
俺たち海の男にはわかるのさ

English.Text: When an old salt like me says you oughta keep your feet on dry land, you listen.

Text: な？　俺の予感は的中だ

English.Text: See? Told ya there was trouble on the horizon.

Text:
でも　あんなでっかいのを
倒しちまうなんて

English.Text: Never imagined you'd haul in a big sucker like that, though.

Text: あんたたち　ただものじゃないな

English.Text: Gotta say, you're an impressive bunch.

Text:
まさか　指名手配中の
アバランチ……じゃないよな

English.Text: Hey, you're not...y'know, those Avalanche fugitives from Midgar?

Text:
まあ　俺も反神羅派だ
見逃してやるさ

English.Text: Wait─don't answer that. I'm a supporter, but...the less I know the better.

Text: 昔の海は　もっと静かだったんだ

English.Text: You wouldn't believe how quiet these waters used to be.

Text:
神羅のでっかい船が通るようになって
海も荒れちまった

English.Text: But ever since Shinra swept in with their big tankers, seas've been rough.

Text:
おまけに　魔晄の垂れ流しでな
海の生態系まで壊れちまった

English.Text: Offshore reactor hasn't helped matters neither. Been leakin' mako from the start, wreakin' havoc on the wildlife.

Text: いつか自然に復讐されるんじゃねえかな

English.Text: Mother Nature ain't happy, and one day...

Text:
なあ　エレベーターであがってった
３人組

English.Text: Hey, you see that trio that took the elevator up top?

Text:
神羅の黒スーツっていえば
タークスとかいうヤバイやつらだよな

English.Text: Had to be Turks. Those suits're unmistakable! Wonder what brought 'em here...

Text:
タークスが来てるってことは　上で
アバランチとドンパチ始まるのかもな

English.Text: Whatever it is, I'm sure it'll bring Avalanche too─and then all hell's gonna break loose.

Text:
上のイベントは
新社長就任パレードだってよ

English.Text: Guess there's some kinda inauguration parade going on up top.

Text:
ああ　タークスが来てたのは
ルーファウス新社長の
警備だったってわけか

English.Text: Aha! Now that would explain why those Turks were here. They must be on bodyguard duty.

Text:
でも　なんで
アンダージュノンに寄ったんだ？

English.Text: But then why cut through Under Junon?

Text:
さあな　会場の安全確保かなんかだろ
いいなあ　俺も警備つけて歩きてえよ

English.Text: Maybe to scope out the place for unsavory elements? Don't ask me. I'm not important enough to need that kind of protection.

Text:
むかしむかし　海の上には共和国の首都
ジュノンがあったのじゃ

English.Text: Many, many years ago, the republic's capital city once floated on these very waters.

Text: 海の上に街なんて　うっそだ～

English.Text: That's stupid. Cities don't float!

Text:
ふふ　大きな船をいくつもつなげて
大きな大きな街にしたんじゃよ

English.Text: It was a large city with many people, built atop a series of connected ships called a flotilla.

Text: おお　かっけ～！

English.Text: That sounds awesome!

Text:
うむうむ
波の上でいつも揺れておったな

English.Text: But it was always rocking back and forth, back and forth.

Text: うわ　気持ち悪くなりそう

English.Text: I think I'd get seasick.

Text:
はっは　住んでるうちに
慣れるもんじゃよ

English.Text: You'd get used to it in time.

Text: 海の上の街は　どうなったの？

English.Text: So what happened to the floating city? Where did it go?

Text:
ふむ　神羅との戦争に負けて
沈んでしまったな

English.Text: Into the depths. Shinra sank it in the war.

Text:
じゃが　いまでも海の底には
お宝を乗せた船がいっぱいじゃ！

English.Text: The flotilla now rests at the bottom of the sea, along with its hidden treasures.

Text: うわ～　すげ～！

English.Text: Hidden treasure? For real!?

Text: もっと聞きたい！

English.Text: I wanna hear about the treasure!

Text:
あの骨は
昔ジュノンでとれた魚の骨さ

English.Text: Believe it or not, those bones over there came from a real fish.

Text:
引きあげるのに　船が何隻も沈みかけて
大変だったって話だ

English.Text: I'll never forget the day we reeled it in. Nearly capsized ten times over, but we caught it.

Text:
いまじゃあ
あの大きさの魚はもうとれない
それでも俺は　ただ海に出るだけだ

English.Text: Won't find a fish that size these days. Not that it stops me from going out looking on the deep blue─or green, as it were.

Text:
魚がいないのなら　いる場所に船を漕ぐ
それが　ジュノンの漁師魂さ

English.Text: In that way we fishermen are stubborn as scissorclaws. Yessir─we'll paddle to the ends of the earth for our catch if we have to.

Text:
反対運動の参加者は
ただちに解散しなさい！

English.Text: Disperse immediately! I repeat─disperse!

Text: エレベーターは封鎖中だ

English.Text: This is your only warning!

Text:
現在　エレベーターの一般使用は禁止だ
いますぐ解散しなさい！

English.Text: The elevator is currently off-limits to civilians! Disperse at once!

Text: 神羅は　エレベーターを解放しろ！

English.Text: Our town, our land, our lift!

Text: 神羅は　エレベーターを解放しろ！

English.Text: Our town, our land, our lift!

Text: 解放しろ！
新社長就任　反対！

English.Text: Junon has no president!

Text: 新社長就任　反対！

English.Text: Junon has no president!

Text: 新社長就任　反対！

English.Text: Junon has no president!

Text: ルーファウス　帰れ！

English.Text: Go home, Rufus! Go home!

Text: ルーファウス　帰れ！

English.Text: Go home, Rufus! Go home!

Text: ルーファウス　帰れ！

English.Text: Go home, Rufus! Go home!

Text: 打倒　神羅！

English.Text: Down. With. Shinra!

Text: 打倒　神羅！

English.Text: Down. With. Shinra!

Text: 打倒　神羅！

共和国時代は　石炭や石油
それから風力なんかを使って
エネルギーを得ていたんだよ

English.Text: Oil, coal, wind... The Republic of Junon had no shortage of ways to generate power.

Text:
魔晄なんて使わなくても生活できるんだ
それなのに　神羅は魔晄に依存させる

English.Text: No need for "mako," no sir. Shinra, though─they couldn't live without it, and they made sure we couldn't either.

Text: 自分たちの利益のためさ

English.Text: Gotta make that money, right?

Text:
神羅の手を借りなくても
生きていけるんだ

English.Text: People never needed Shinra to survive.

Text: みんな　すっかり忘れちまったがね

English.Text: But somewhere along the line, we forgot how...

Text:
黒マントのヤツら　どこにいったんだ？
このへんの廃墟に住んでたよな

English.Text: Where'd those robed fellas run off to? Coulda sworn I saw 'em hangin' around the ruins.

Text:
ああ　あいつらなら
すこしまえに上に行ったみたいよ

English.Text: If you're looking for them for whatever reason, I saw 'em head up top not too long ago.

Text:
自分たちで動いたのかよ　珍しいな
薬でももらいに行ったのかな

English.Text: All together in a group? Didn't expect that. Maybe they went looking for a doctor?

Text:
あいつら　くさいし
いなくなって清々するわ

English.Text: Good riddance, I say. They stunk to high heaven.

Text:
上には　けっこうな数の
黒マントがいるんだってな

English.Text: Must be a crowd up there now, what with the others.

Text:
ジュノンは軍事要塞だからね
戦争の犠牲者をかくまってるんじゃない

English.Text: Well, Junon is a military base. Makes sense that refugees would seek shelter here.

Text: 船員仲間に聞いたんだけどよ

English.Text: So I was talking with a sailor friend of mine...

Text:
このへんに住んでた黒マントたち
連絡船で海を渡ったらしい

English.Text: and he said those robed guys managed to board the Shinra-8 and cross the dang sea.

Text:
なに　コスタに遊びにでも行ったの？
神羅の慰安旅行かしら

English.Text: What, they up and decided to take a vacation in Costa del Sol on Shinra's gil?

Text:
星の民よ
星の声に耳を傾けるのだ

English.Text: Children of the planet─listen! Heed the voice of our great mother.

Text:
星の嘆き　星の悲しみ　星の苦しみ
星は　いまも悲鳴をあげている

English.Text: Hear how she weeps─how she suffers! How she cries out, even now, for deliverance from pain─a pain that we, her children, are inflicting upon her!

Text:
ジュノンの海を見よ
生命の失せた海を！

English.Text: If you want proof, then look to the waters─devoid of their vibrancy!

Text: 魔晄が海の命を削っている

English.Text: And what is to blame for this? Mako.

Text:
海の命を軽んじれば
やがて人の命も尽き果てる

English.Text: Shinra's "miracle" has befouled your seas. But I promise you─it will not stop there!

Text:
この海のように
ゆるやかに滅び去ろう

English.Text: It will come for your shores, your crops─the air you breathe!

Text:
ライフストリームを絶やしてはならぬ
我らの命が　星とともにあらんことを！

English.Text: The lifestream must be preserved! It is the essence of our planet─the very thing that sustains us─and we must not bleed our mother dry!

Text:
ガボン牧場のチョコボ運送
最近　見ないよな

English.Text: You seen Gabe lately? Feels like he hasn't come by in ages.

Text:
なんか　また神羅にやられたって噂よ
もう廃業するんじゃないかな

English.Text: I heard that Shinra cracked down on him and the birds again. He might have to close down the business for good this time.

Text:
マジか　グラスランドから
木材仕入れられないと　困るな

English.Text: You gotta be kidding me. Seriously? Then how in the hell are we supposed to get all the lumber we need?

Text:
ガボンさんのチョコボ運送
再開したってさ！

English.Text: Whaddya know: Gabe and his birds are back in business!

Text: ちょっと値上げしたみたいだけどな

English.Text: Bumped his rates up a little to boot.

Text: それだけ　やる気あるってことでしょ

English.Text: Just shows he's got faith in the brand.

Text:
へへ　さっそく
なんか運んでもらおうぜ

English.Text: I better hurry up and put in an order.

Text: なんの騒ぎだったんだよ

English.Text: What was that about?

Text: あの人　ソルジャーだよな？

English.Text: That guy was a SOLDIER, right?

Text: アバランチの捜索に来たのか？

English.Text: Prob'ly came lookin' for Avalanche.

Text: バイク　うるさかったなあ

English.Text: That bike about burst my eardrums.

Text: 戦いになるのかと思ったぜ

English.Text: I was sure a fight was gonna break out.

Text:
さっきのバイクの人
かっこいい～！

English.Text: Did you see the guy on the motorcycle? What a hunk!

Text: 神羅は面倒しか起こさない

English.Text: Shinra only knows how to raise mayhem.

Text:
マイフレンドって
呼ばれてみたいかも！

English.Text: Oh, I'd like to be his friend...

Text: もう　いい迷惑！

English.Text: Ugh! What an asshole!

Text:
もしかして
アバランチがこの村にいるの？

English.Text: Wait a minute─does this mean that Avalanche is here?

Text:
ルーファウスが来るらしいな
いまが文句を言うチャンスじゃないか？

English.Text: Rufus is comin' to Junon! Now's our chance to raise some hell and be heard!

Text:
漁に行くぞ
神羅がなにしようが関係ねえ

English.Text: I'm a fisherman, not a businessman. Shinra ain't no concern of mine.

Text:
魚焼きまくって　けむたくして
パレードを妨害してやる

English.Text: Oughta hold a big ol' cookout─let their parade choke on the smoke.

Text:
上で式典だってよ
さっさと終わってくれないかな

English.Text: Can't wait for that damned parade of theirs to be over and done with.

Text:
新社長になるからって
神羅は　変わらないよな

English.Text: Just 'cause there's a new president doesn't mean Shinra's gonna do a one-eighty.

Text:
ルーファウス神羅が来てるんだって！
見に行きたいわ～

English.Text: Isn't that something. The new president─here, in Junon!

Text:
社長が代わって
ここの暮らしもよくなるといいな

English.Text: Life down here's been hard. Maybe a change in leadership will help with that.

Text:
新社長は　ボーナス大盤振る舞いとか
してくれないかな

English.Text: Think the new prez will, iunno, throw us a bone? We're hurtin'.

Text:
パレードって盛りあがるよね
テレビで見なきゃ

English.Text: Not every day that a parade comes to town! It'll be televised, right?

Text:
サイドジュノンの青年団が
騒がなきゃいいけど

English.Text: Hope the Crow's Nest folks don't try anything stupid.

Text: なにか事件でも起きたのか

English.Text: What's going on? Did something happen!?

Text: おいおい　どうなってんだよ

English.Text: This is all too much!

Text: ここは安全なのか？

English.Text: My knees are knocking...

Text: ちくしょう　どうすりゃいいんだ

English.Text: This is terrible... What do we do?

Text: 助けてくれ……

English.Text: Can't help but be worried.

Text: なに　どうなってるの？

English.Text: This better not be a joke...!

Text: えっ　もしかしてヤバい状況？

English.Text: Someone...do something.

Text: いったい　なんなの？

English.Text: What in the world is that?

Text: これ　まずいんじゃない？

English.Text: That can't be good...

Text: なにも起きないで　お願い……

English.Text: It's nothing serious, right?

Text:
ルーファウスが襲撃されるなんて
いい気味だよ

English.Text: Man I wish I'd been there when they tried to kill the son of a bitch.

Text:
上へのエレベーターは
封鎖されたままなんだ

English.Text: Elevator's been shut down since shit hit the fan upstairs.

Text: ジュノンの警備が強化されちまったよ

English.Text: Security's been real tight ever since the parade.

Text: 新社長を襲ったのはアバランチなのか？

English.Text: Was the assassin with Avalanche, or...?

Text:
ルーファウスを狙ったのは
ウータイなんだよな？

English.Text: Everybody knows that Wutai was behind the attack.

Text: ルーファウスさん　無事なのかしら

English.Text: You don't think Rufus was hurt, do you?

Text:
あたしたちの生活は
なにも変わらないのよね

English.Text: Was stupid of me to think a new president would do anything for us.

Text: 神羅カンパニーの今後が心配だわ

English.Text: Shinra's gonna be out for blood, you'll see.

Text:
相手がアバランチでもウータイでも
戦争はイヤかな～

English.Text: The last thing we need is for a war to break out. Got enough problems already.

Text:
サイドジュノンの青年団
盛りあがってるんでしょうね

English.Text: Bet you anything the folks over in the Crow's Nest are eating this up.

Text:
上の騒ぎの次は　戦争の噂
どうなっちまうんだ

English.Text: First an assassin at the parade, and now a war!? Gimme a goddamn break...

Text:
戦争が起きたら
ここも巻き込まれるのか

English.Text: We got no beef with the SRC. They wouldn't start trouble here.

Text:
反神羅のやつらが手を結べば
神羅もヤバイよな

English.Text: I tell ya, Shinra better pray the SRC don't come around here recruitin'.

Text:
まあ　ジュノンの大砲がありゃ
安心だよな

English.Text: No one would dare take on Junon's cannon. We'll be fine.

Text:
連絡会ってのは
サイドジュノンも関わってんのかね

English.Text: So...the Crow's Nest is working with the SRC, then?

Text:
なにがあっても
子供たちだけは守らないとね

English.Text: The safety of our children has to be our top priority.

Text: 私たちまで　狙われないと良いんだけど

English.Text: Hey, you don't think they'd try to hit us here, do you?

Text:
暗殺とか戦争よりも
髪のいたみのほうが深刻

English.Text: Shinra and its war can get bent. It's these friggin' split ends I'm worried about!

Text:
神羅との戦いは望んでいたはずなのに
いざとなると
やめてほしいって願っちゃう

English.Text: I always wanted someone to stick it to Shinra, but if that means turning Junon into a warzone? I dunno...

Text:
ルーファウス様だけは
生き残ってくれないかしら

English.Text: Rufus'll come out on top. The rich and powerful always do.

Text: よしよし　いい輝きだな

English.Text: Don't worry, little lady. I'll fix you up good as new.

Text:
いつか漁に出られる日のために
しっかり磨くぞ

English.Text: Then one day we can take to the seas again and do what we do best.

Text: きゅっきゅっきゅーっと

English.Text: We'll get you lookin' shiny and new in no time.

Text: 僕のことも磨いてほしい……

English.Text: Wish he'd give me the same TLC.

Text:
おんや　珍しいねえ
旅人がこの村にやってくるなんてねえ

English.Text: Been an age since we've seen travelers like yourselves. No one save Shinra folk ever bother with us.

Text:
よければ　道具屋や武器屋で
買い物をしていってくれんか？

English.Text: Don't suppose ya might consider stockin' up on provisions while in town?

Text:
わしの店はもう潰れて無いが
まだ　あの店はやっとる

English.Text: My own store's long gone, but those ones there are still holdin' on.

Text:
ひやかしだけでも良いんじゃ
客が来るだけでも嬉しいからのう

English.Text: I'm sure they'd welcome you with open arms, even if you don't end up buying anything from 'em.

Text:
戦争の後に
神羅が上の街を作ってから……

English.Text: I swear, ever since Shinra came and built that blasted hunk of junk above us...

Text:
魚も　さっぱりとれんわ
海が汚れてしもうてな

English.Text: These waters have been so polluted with filth that I haven't seen a single fish! What's a man of the sea like me s'posed to do?

Text:
また　戦争になるんか？
戦争にかこつけて神羅はやりたい放題だ

English.Text: So─we're in for another war, are we? Great. Now Shinra'll have even more excuses to go forth and do as they please.

Text:
海の次は
空まで汚されるかのう……

English.Text: You mark my words, they'll start muckin' up the sky next.

Text:
同じことの繰り返し　いったい
いつまで続くんじゃろうな

English.Text: The world turns and turns, but somehow they keep comin' out on top. Is there nothin' we can do to put an end to it?

Text:
エレベーターは使用禁止だってよ
ジュノンでの仕入れも延期しろとか

English.Text: Elevator's on lockdown for us bottom-feeders... Which means no new provisions today.

Text: なんだよ　くそ

English.Text: Friggin' bullshit...

Text:
おかげで　今日もメシは
うちで作った干物だぞ

English.Text: Hope I've still got a chunk of that homemade jerky lyin' around...

Text: 俺たちも干からびろってのか

English.Text: They tryin' to starve us out?

Text: なんだ　新社長就任パレードって

English.Text: An inauguration parade... Ya gotta be shittin' me.

Text:
ルーファウスってのは
相当な見栄っぱりだな

English.Text: How narcissistic can one rich asshole be?

Text:
わざわざジュノンに来てまで
目立ちたいのかよ

English.Text: We get it, Rufus. You're a big boy now!

Text: ああもう　毎日塩漬け干物づくし

English.Text: Every damn meal, pickled friggin' fish. I'm sick of it.

Text:
新社長に代わっても
俺たちの生活はなんも変わらねえよ

English.Text: Doesn't matter who's at the head of the table─we're always gonna be forced to eat scraps.

Text:
神羅の漁船はデカイから
揺れが少ないのはいいよな

English.Text: Shinra's rigs're sturdy as all hell─so big they barely rock!

Text: おう　船酔いもナシだ

English.Text: Which means no more seasickness.

Text:
甲板の掃除やら網の片付けやら
雑用だけど
海に出る仕事につけただけマシだぜ

English.Text: Granted, swabbin' the deck and untanglin' nets ain't glamorous work, but better to be out there than stuck on shore.

Text:
昇進したら
自分の船を持てるって話なんだ

English.Text: Plus it gives us more opportunities to prove that we're officer material!

Text:
俺の船が先か
おまえの船が先か　競争だな

English.Text: Who d'ya think'll get licensed first─me or you? Wanna make a bet?

Text: え～と　なんだっけ……

English.Text: Okay, where was I?

Text:
ああ　みなさん！
あたし　サイドジュノンの
反神羅青年団から来ました

English.Text: My friends! I represent the anti-Shinra forces of the Crow's Nest.

Text:
みんなで力を合わせて
神羅から海を取り戻しましょう！

English.Text: Do you believe the company has gone too far? That they must be stopped?

Text:
神羅はきれいな海を
魔晄で汚しました

English.Text: Shinra's mako has ruined our ocean.

Text:
いつもくさいし
変な形のお魚しかとれなくなりました

English.Text: It has tarnished our beaches─destroyed our livelihoods!

Text:
あたし　おいしいお魚を
お刺身で食べたいんです

English.Text: When was the last time you all felt safe eating your own catch?

Text:
プリップリで
脂がのった　新鮮なお刺身！

English.Text: The last time you had fish so fresh you could eat it raw?

Text:
えっ　お客さん？
い……いらっしゃい！

English.Text: Wait. You want to buy something? Here? Okay!

Text: やった　お客さんだ～！

English.Text: Omigosh, actual customers!

Text: またのご利用　お待ちしてまーす！

English.Text: Come back again... Please?

Text: ほんと　ありがとうございました！

English.Text: Thank you so, so much!

Text: たまには買い物してやらないと

English.Text: Sometimes window-shopping ain't enough.

Text:
流行りもの
置いてないんだよな～

English.Text: Talk about a lame selection...

Text: 上からの仕入れが大変みたいね

English.Text: They must've cracked down on the supply route.

Text: う～ん　どれにしようかな

English.Text: Hmm. Didn't think it'd be this tough to decide.

Text: いらっしゃい　強くなってくれ

English.Text: Hey there─looking to augment your folios?

Text: へへへ　さあどうする？

English.Text: So, what'll it be?

Text: まあ　いい感じってとこか？

English.Text: Well, hope you found what you needed.

Text: また寄ってくれよ！

English.Text: Come back soon!

Text: マンガは置いてねえのか？

English.Text: So they don't have comics?

Text: なんか古い本ばっかだな

English.Text: They got any new books here?

Text: 古本のニオイっていいわ

English.Text: I just love that old-book smell.

Text: 危ない本はないかな

English.Text: Where d'they keep the smutty stuff?

Text:
いらっしゃい！
くつろいでけよ

English.Text: Hey, good to have ya! Take a load off!

Text: よく来た　飲んでけ飲んでけ！

English.Text: You're lookin' parched! Let's get you a drink!

Text:
もともと俺の店は　船の上にあったんだ
客が多いと船が沈みかけたほどさ

English.Text: This tavern used to be on a ship in the harbor, you know. Got so low in the water when it was hoppin', you'd think she might sink.

Text:
海に　酒樽つるしてよ
波の揺れでカクテルかきまわしてたな

English.Text: Had this thing where we'd toss a bunch of shakers in a barrel─let the waves mix the drinks for us.

Text:
本日　神羅カンパニー広報部の
会見が開かれました

English.Text: At an official Shinra press conference held earlier today...

Text:
ジュノンで行われる
神羅カンパニーの式典は
予定通り　明日開催されます

English.Text: a spokesperson confirmed that the inauguration in Junon will be held tomorrow as scheduled.

Text:
軍事拠点である
要塞都市ジュノンでの式典が
どんな内容や規模になるのか

English.Text: What exciting festivities does our new company president have in store for the city?

Text:
全世界の注目が
ジュノンに集まっています

English.Text: Make sure to tune in tomorrow to find out.

Text:
続いて　ミッドガルへの破壊活動で
指名手配されている反神羅組織
アバランチ捜索関連の続報です

English.Text: We have received new information regarding Avalanche, the anti-Shinra group responsible for multiple terrorist attacks in Midgar.

Text:
治安維持部門からの発表によると
アバランチは　現在も逃亡中であり

English.Text: According to a recent statement from Public Security, key members remain at large...

Text:
カームに潜伏していた協力者も
逮捕には至っておりません

English.Text: and those who concealed them in Kalm have yet to be apprehended.

Text:
神羅カンパニーは
カームの協力者も含めて　引き続き
アバランチの捜索を続けていくとの事で

English.Text: Shinra is asking citizens to come forward if they have information concerning Avalanche's current whereabouts...

Text: 市民への情報提供を呼びかけています

English.Text: or the identities of their associates.

Text:
本日　神羅カンパニーの新たなリーダー
ルーファウス新社長の
就任パレードが行われます

English.Text: Today, the Shinra Electric Power Company is celebrating the inauguration of Rufus Shinra.

Text:
開催地となる要塞都市ジュノンには
多くの人々が
新社長の雄姿を見るべく訪れています

English.Text: Many people have flocked to Junon for the chance to see his first official appearance as commander in chief.

Text:
式典では今後の神羅カンパニーについて
ルーファウス新社長の
就任演説が　行われます

English.Text: The president will also give his first public address, in which he is expected to outline his vision for the future.

Text:
現在　様々な問題を抱える
神羅カンパニーに
新しい風を吹かすことができるのか
期待されています

English.Text: While this remains a difficult period for Shinra, there is hope that the transition will mark a turning point for the company.

Text:
なにが式典だよ
勝手ばっかしやがって

English.Text: Ceremony-shmeremony. It's an excuse for them to show off.

Text:
上が盛りあがるなら
オレたちも負けちゃいられねえ

English.Text: We know how to live it up too! Let's go till dawn, baby!

Text:
式典だかなんだか知らねえが
酒盛りだ！

English.Text: Who cares what the occasion is─I'll drink to it!

Text:
上に行けたら　式典に来る男
捕まえられるのに

English.Text: If only I could move up top─maybe there I'd meet the man of my dreams.

Text:
アバランチって
まだ捕まってないの？

English.Text: How have they still not caught Avalanche?

Text:
無駄遣いする金あるんなら
アタシがもらいたいね

English.Text: Got money for parades but not for the people, huh?

Text:
新社長就任パレードか
ドキドキするぜ

English.Text: Parade for the new president's inauguration, huh? Could be interesting.

Text:
上には負けねえ
オレたちも盛りあがるぞ！

English.Text: They think they know how to party? They ain't seen nothin' yet!

Text: 中継の時も　この場所確保な

English.Text: Gotta keep this spot for the main event.

Text:
ジュノンでも
アバランチが暴れたりしないかな

English.Text: Would be nice if Avalanche could stir things up around here too.

Text:
新社長になっても
あたしたちには関係ないよね

English.Text: Who cares who the new president is? Won't change anything for us.

Text: パレードの間に何杯飲めるか　競争ね

English.Text: Gonna need a lot more drinks in me to enjoy the show.

Text:
はいはい
みんなたくさん飲んでね！

English.Text: Don't be shy! Keep knockin' 'em back!

Text:
あんたたちの酒代が
あたしの稼ぎになるんだよ

English.Text: The more you drink, the more you give back to the community!

Text: う～ん　塩味きいてるね

English.Text: Hoo boy... Now that's what I call salty.

Text: ここの魚料理はうまいんだよ

English.Text: The chef here really knows how to cook a fish!

Text: 俺は船上酒場時代からの常連だよ

English.Text: Been a regular here since the place was still on a ship!

Text: うわ　海の砂入ってる～

English.Text: Why is there still sand in my shoe!?

Text: ヘルシーな貝料理がオススメよ

English.Text: Shellfish is good for the body and soul!

Text:
もうちょっと
カラフルだといいと思うんだけど

English.Text: I'm used to eating food with a little more color...

Text: うふふ　遊んでく？

English.Text: Hehe, love the outfit.

Text: ねえ　１杯おごってくれない？

English.Text: What I wouldn't give for a drink right now.

Text: サイドジュノン反神羅青年団です

English.Text: We're recruiting for Crows Against Shinra!

Text: みなさん　神羅と戦いましょう！

English.Text: Let's stand up to our corporate oppressors!

Text: ジュノンの海を取り戻しましょう！

English.Text: Let's take back the sea for Junon!

Text: サイドジュノン反神羅青年団です

English.Text: We're recruiting for Crows Against Shinra!

Text: みなさん　神羅と戦いましょう！

English.Text: Let's stand up to our corporate oppressors!

Text: ジュノンの海を取り戻しましょう！

English.Text: Let's take back the sea for Junon!

Text: 臨時ニュースをお伝えします

English.Text: And now breaking news.

Text:
ジュノンで行われた
神羅カンパニーの式典で

English.Text: Rufus Shinra, our newly appointed president...

Text:
ルーファウス新社長が
襲撃される事件がありました

English.Text: was attacked during his inauguration in Junon.

Text:
幸い　ルーファウス新社長にケガはなく
業務に支障もないとのことです

English.Text: Thankfully, he was uninjured and was able to assume his new position without delay.

Text:
治安維持部門の発表によりますと
犯行当時　ウータイ人とみられる
不審な女性が式典会場の近くで
目撃されたという証言があり

English.Text: Public Security has confirmed that multiple eyewitnesses observed a young woman, believed to be of Wutaian origin, behaving erratically shortly before the incident.

Text: 事件との関連を調査中とのことです

English.Text: Authorities are investigating her involvement...

Text:
また　アバランチの関与につきましても
今後明らかにしていくとしています

English.Text: as well as her potential connections to Avalanche and other insurgent groups.

Text:
先日発生した　反神羅連絡会
およびウータイ暫定政府による
電波ジャックの続報です

English.Text: The illegal broadcast from the Shinra Resistance Committee and the interim Wutaian government has left many fearful of future attacks.

Text:
神羅カンパニーは　住民の間で
不安の声が高まっているのを受け

English.Text: The Shinra Electric Power Company regrets the distress inflicted upon the people...

Text:
近日中に　ルーファウス新社長による
声明文を発表するとしています

English.Text: and has promised to make a public statement in the near future to address their concerns.

Text:
また　治安維持部門は
錯綜する情報に惑わされず

English.Text: Public Security anticipates a rise in misinformation in the coming days...

Text:
いつもどおりの生活を心掛けるよう
呼びかけています

English.Text: and is encouraging everyone to go about their lives as normal.

Text: よお　いらっしゃい！

English.Text: Hello, hello, hello!

Text: フハハ　なんか買ってけよ

English.Text: Hahaha! What can I do ya for?

Text: フハハ　いつでも歓迎だ！

English.Text: Haha! Don't be a stranger!

Text: そんじゃ　気をつけてな

English.Text: You take care of yourself, okay?

Text: 漁に使う銛を探してんだ

English.Text: I'm lookin' for a quality harpoon.

Text: 魚釣りの道具も売っているな

English.Text: So they got fishing gear too, huh.

Text: 銃でカモメを撃っちゃダメよ

English.Text: Hey─don't go shootin' the seagulls.

Text: この剣　買うか迷うわねえ

English.Text: I should just do it. Just buy the sword!

Text:
こんな海でも
散歩するのは気持ちいいぜ

English.Text: It's still nice to walk the beach, even with the sea a mess.

Text:
海の魔晄色で
今日の運勢占ってるんだ

English.Text: "The brighter the ocean mako, the brighter your day!"

Text:
たまには　カモメに
エサやりでもするかなあ

English.Text: Bet the seagulls are hungry. I should feed 'em.

Text: さ～て　今日はなにが釣れるかな

English.Text: Alright! Let's see what's biting today!

Text:
海を見てボーッとするのが
日課なんだよ

English.Text: Nothing makes you forget a bad day like staring at the ocean.

Text:
最近じゃ　網にかかるのは
モンスターばかりよ

English.Text: Lately I've been bringin' in nothing but sea devils...

Text: イルカちゃん　かわいいな

English.Text: That dolphin's so adorable.

Text:
ウータイのシノビってのが
偵察にでも来たら　いよいよ
終わりが近いのかもしれないよ

English.Text: Bet we'll be hearing rumors of ninjas here soon. After that, won't be long until kaboom...

Text:
魔晄色の海でも
深いところは　まだ青いの

English.Text: Ocean may look like it's in dire straits but...life finds a way.

Text: ぷりぷり……思い出すのう

English.Text: Boy, oh boy. Now this takes me way back.

Text:
漁のあと　とれたての魚をさばいて
その場で食ったもんじゃ

English.Text: Hookin' some nice fish, bringing 'em back to gut and fillet, then eatin' 'em on the spot.

Text:
ぷりぷり……
港のおなごもたくましくてのう

English.Text: You didn't wanna mess with the gals workin' the port, neither. Hoo.

Text: な～に昔の話じゃ　ホッホ

English.Text: Oh, listen to me, goin' on about the old days.

Text:
右よし　左よし
異状な～し！

English.Text: Nothing here, nothing there...all clear!

Text:
子供たちが安心して遊べるように
海を監視してるんだ

English.Text: Thanks to our tireless efforts, the ocean remains safe.

Text: 干物作りは　とっても奥が深いのよ

English.Text: With all the ways to cure fish, it's practically an art form.

Text:
右よし　左よし
異状な～し！

English.Text: Clear right, clear left...and we're good!

Text:
釣り人も来るから
万がいちに備えてるの

English.Text: Gotta stay vigilant. Never know when fiends'll strike.

Text:
お～い　エサだぞ～
集まれ集まれ！

English.Text: Alright, everyone, come and get it! Don't wanna miss feedin' time, do ya?

Text:
ほ～ら　食え食え
いっぱい食えよ

English.Text: That's it. Eat up now. I know ya must be starving.

Text:
昔は釣り舟が
たくさん出ていたのよ

English.Text: Back in the day, it was lousy with fishing boats...

Text: ショータイム　はじめるぞ！

English.Text: It's showtime, people!

Text: ショータイム　やるよ～！

English.Text: The show's about to start!

Text: よ～しよ～し

English.Text: Good job out there.

Text: えらかったね

English.Text: You did great.

Text: あの子　大丈夫か？

English.Text: She gonna be okay!?

Text: 自警団はどこいったんだ

English.Text: Shouldn't someone be on patrol!?

Text: はやく浜にあがるんだ！

English.Text: Get out of the water! Now!

Text: きゃあああ　危ない！

English.Text: Hey! Look out!

Text: なんとかしなきゃ

English.Text: We gotta save her...

Text: 誰か　助けてあげて！

English.Text: Somebody do something!

Text: 事故がなくて　本当に良かったよ

English.Text: What a relief this didn't turn out worse.

Text: なんとか無事だったな

English.Text: I'm so glad she wasn't hurt.

Text: おぼれかけたのに　元気だなあ

English.Text: Wow, that didn't faze her at all.

Text: あの子　たくましいわね

English.Text: That girl's certainly something, isn't she?

Text: やっぱり魔晄の海は危険だよ

English.Text: We really need to shut that reactor down.

Text:
あんな危ないのが
海にひそんでるんだね

English.Text: Don't wanna think about what else is lurking in these waters...

Text:
上の式典が終わるまで
船は出せねえんだ　すまんな

English.Text: Sorry, the ship won't be leaving port until the festivities are over.

Text:
コスタ・デル・ソルへ行きたいんなら
ジュノン港まで運んでやろうか？

English.Text: If you're thinking of heading to Costa del Sol, I'd be happy to take you to the port.

Text:
あとは連絡船に乗り換えて
気がつけば　コスタ～ってなわけよ

English.Text: Ya gotta book a ticket on the ferry, but once you're aboard, it's a straight shot to paradise.

Text: どうする　乗ってくか？

English.Text: Well? You comin'?

Text: コスタ・デル・ソルに行くなら　乗ってくか？

English.Text: Headed for Costa del Sol? Hop aboard!

Text: よし　面舵いっぱ～い！

English.Text: And we're off! Be there before ya know it!

Text: 乗りたくなったら　いつでも声をかけな

English.Text: Gimme a shout whenever you wanna hitch a ride.

Text: ここは　子供しか入れないよ

English.Text: Only kids allowed in here.

Text: 大人は入れませ～ん

English.Text: No grown-ups.

Text:
昔は岸から離れなくても
魚がとれたんだがな

English.Text: In the old days, you could make ends meet just fishin' off the shore.

Text:
いまじゃ　沖合まで行かなきゃ
漁ができないんだ

English.Text: Now you gotta go out into the bay to get yourself a nibble.

Text:
でっかい船で魚を乱獲すりゃあ
そりゃ　もうかるさ

English.Text: 'Course, if you trawl the waters with a company ship, you're bound to rake it in.

Text:
けど　俺みたいな
昔かたぎの漁師に言わせりゃ

English.Text: Ain't any easier or more efficient way to fish, true.

Text:
効率がいいだけで
魚の気持ちがわからねえよ

English.Text: But if ya ask me, it's like bitin' the hand that feeds.

Text:
神羅の船に乗ってたとしても
ジュノンの漁師魂は忘れたくねえよな

English.Text: I respect the sea, and it'll be a cold day in hell before I work a Shinra ship.

Text:
この海の底には海底魔晄炉があるんだ
グツグツと　いまも魔晄を吐き出してる

English.Text: Believe it or not, there's a reactor at the bottom of this bay, sucking mako from the seabed like a man dying of thirst.

Text:
海底魔晄炉の魔晄エネルギーは
ジュノンの兵器生産に使われる

English.Text: And all that energy gets used for─you guessed it─weapons production.

Text:
ウータイとの戦争が起これば
ここは真っ先に狙われるだろうね

English.Text: Unsurprisingly, that makes it a prime target if we got into another war with Wutai.

Text: いらっしゃいませ　ご利用ですか？

English.Text: Welcome. Need some rooms?

Text: いってらっしゃいませ

English.Text: Have a nice day.

Text:
アハハハ
君も青年団に入るのか？

English.Text: Lemme guess─lookin' to join up?

Text:
サイドジュノンにようこそ
いいとこだろう？

English.Text: Welcome to the Crow's Nest. Pretty sweet, right?

Text:
新しいジュノンを作るんだ
具体的なことは　まだ考えてないけど

English.Text: We're building a new republic! Dunno what that means, but...it's happening!

Text: 豊かな海を取り戻そう！

English.Text: Help us take back our seas!

Text: 次はどこにポスター貼りに行くかな

English.Text: Where's the best spot to put up a poster, y'think?

Text:
あたし　アバランチに
知り合いがいるんだ

English.Text: I have a friend in Avalanche! Well, acquaintance.

Text:
反神羅青年団の同志よ
サイドジュノンへようこそ！

English.Text: All those willing to fight against Shinra's tyranny are welcome in the Crow's Nest!

Text:
反神羅青年団の同志よ
共に戦おう！

English.Text: Crows Against Shinra welcomes all those who believe in freedom!

Text:
外はモンスターだらけだ
気をつけていけ

English.Text: Careful! Monsters have the run of the hills around here!

Text:
反神羅青年団の同志よ
また会おう！

English.Text: Make sure to come back to us alive and well, fellow freedom fighter!

Text:
新人の活動は
ビラ配りとかポスター貼りとか
雑用ばっかなんでしょ？

English.Text: I get that we're brand new to the CAS, but handing out flyers and posting signs is getting old quick.

Text: 何年所属しても同じらしい

English.Text: Well, better get used to it.

Text:
街頭演説とかデモ行進は
先輩が仕切るってよ

English.Text: Only senior members get to do the cool stuff, like the rallies.

Text:
はあ　私は神羅と戦いたくて
志願したんだけど

English.Text: I didn't sign up to carry stacks of paper around Junon.

Text:
そういう危ないのは
アバランチに入れってさ

English.Text: Then ya joined the wrong people. Maybe consider Avalanche?

Text:
ジュノンの美しく豊かな海を
取り戻しましょう

English.Text: We're gonna reclaim these waters and make 'em beautiful again!

Text:
ついに神羅と戦えるのね！
ビラ配りの毎日とは　おさらばよ

English.Text: I could kiss the SRC right now! So long flyers, and hellooo war!

Text:
うちは街頭演説とかやって
最前線はアバランチとウータイの連中に
まかせるんだってさ

English.Text: Easy. Our place is on the streets, rallying people to the cause─not the front lines.

Text: 後方支援も立派な戦いだって

English.Text: It's a boring job, but someone's gotta do it.

Text:
もういい！
そんなんだったら出ていくわ

English.Text: Yeah, well, that "someone" isn't gonna be me!

Text:
海を神羅から取り戻したあとは
どうするんだ？

English.Text: So...what's the plan once we take back our waters?

Text:
海底魔晄炉を占拠して
オレたちの管理にするんだろ

English.Text: First we occupy the offshore reactor─bring it under our control.

Text:
だが　魔晄炉を使い続けたら
魔晄汚染は減らないぞ

English.Text: Then what? Keep using it? Mako's ruining our lives.

Text: 水力か風力に変えればいいんじゃね？

English.Text: Convert it to a..."hydropower" plant?

Text: オレたちにできるかな

English.Text: So you're an engineer now?

Text: あっ！　神羅に頼むか

English.Text: Hey...I got it! We ask Shinra to...

Text: あら　新人さんね

English.Text: I take it you're new to the Nest...?

Text: はあ～　うめえ

English.Text: Mm, that's the stuff.

Text: 空　大きいな～

English.Text: The sky stretches on forever...

Text:
ふわ～あ……
鳥の数　かぞえるの飽きたな

English.Text: Wish there was something better to do than count birds.

Text: ふわ～あ　ねむ～い……

English.Text: I've never been so sleepy...

Text: きゃははは　笑える～

English.Text: Hahaha, you're hilarious.

Text: はあ～　すいこまれそう～

English.Text: Wow... Was the sky always this big?

Text: 武闘派はお断りよ

English.Text: Violence isn't the answer.

Text: 演説ばかりで疲れちゃった

English.Text: These people need to get off their soapboxes.

Text:
アンダージュノンが嫌で出てきたのに
顔見知りばっかりだよな

English.Text: Wanted to get away from Under Junon, but all I see are the same faces.

Text: 世間はせまいよ

English.Text: Small world, I suppose.

Text:
よっし　星命学の聖地
コスモキャニオンでも目指すか

English.Text: Screw it. I should just go to Cosmo Canyon and study planetology.

Text: 世界は広いよ

English.Text: It's a big world out there.

Text:
あたし　クレア先輩みたいな
大恋愛にあこがれるわ

English.Text: Claire's really lucky. Talk about a love story for the ages.

Text: ディランとはここで出会ったのよね

English.Text: She met Dillan here, didn't she?

Text:
トビーは
あなたのことがイイらしいわ

English.Text: Maybe Toby could be your Dillan.

Text:
でも　トビーは
あなたにアタックしてたよね

English.Text: The same Toby who was making moves on you?

Text:
っていうか
あいつは誰でも手当たり次第か

English.Text: No way. That guy's too big a flirt for my taste.

Text: 軽い男なんて最悪

English.Text: Maybe I'm just over men in general.

Text: わたしは　あなたのことが好き

English.Text: Then would you consider dating...me?

Text: えっ……

English.Text: Huh?

Text: あたしたちコンドル観測隊のかわら版

English.Text: Our latest newsletter's looking pretty good!

Text:
『安全第一　コンドル予報』
みんな　読んでくれるかな

English.Text: Clear Skies: A Condor-watcher's Guide... Hope people read it.

Text:
うんうん　ここは
コンドルさんのお散歩ルートだから
危ないこともあるって　伝えなきゃね

English.Text: They better. It's a seriously important topic! We have to respect the condor, so it can respect us. We're the ones intruding on its home, after all!

Text:
『安全第一　コンドル予報』最新号！
今回はゲストを迎えての観察会だね

English.Text: Latest condor newsletter's up! Still can't believe we had such a good sighting. That was a real stroke of luck for our guests!

Text:
うん　コンドル観察の魅力を
伝えたいんだ

English.Text: Oh my gosh, I know! I just wish more people could've been there to see it.

Text: もっとメンバーが増えるといいよね

English.Text: Well, maybe this issue'll get us more members.

Text:
うんうん　これからもがんばって
かわら版作ろう！

English.Text: And if not this one, the next! I've already got ideas for articles!

Text:
仕事に困ったら
掲示板で探すって聞いたけど

English.Text: I heard the best way to get work was through the noticeboard, but...

Text: 俺たちにできそうな仕事はねえなあ

English.Text: There isn't a single job here we can handle.

Text:
ここに来てから
なまっちまったしな

English.Text: I'm just so outta shape since moving to the Nest...

Text: おまえ　昔からなんもしてないだろ

English.Text: Um, when have you ever been in shape?

Text:
コンドルの丘には
でっかいコンドルが飛んでくるんだ

English.Text: I'm trying to spot the eponymous bird of Condor Hill.

Text:
コンドルは閉ざされた島の
守り神らしいんだが
その島には　近寄る方法がない

English.Text: Apparently, it protects the island─not sure from whom, though, seeing as there's no way for us to get over there.

Text:
観測隊の連中も
ここから見守るしかないんだ

English.Text: Only thing we can do is try to catch a glimpse from a distance.

Text:
岬の灯台は
共和国時代から使われていた
歴史ある建物なんだ

English.Text: The lighthouse on the cape dates back to the old republic. Man, if those walls could talk...

Text:
はい　あそこなら
モンスター監視任務で行きました

English.Text: Speaking of, didn't we send people out there to watch for bandits or something?

Text:
最近　妙なヤツが入り込んだみたいで
トビーさんたちが調べてるんだよ

English.Text: Toby's team, yeah. Some yahoo thought it'd be the perfect place to hang their hat.

Text: 盗賊に荒らされたりしなきゃいいですね

English.Text: Well, I hope they don't trash the place.

Text:
おうよ　遺跡を守るのも
青年団の重要な仕事だ

English.Text: We'll make sure they don't. Preserving republic sites is an important part of the job!

Text:
子供たちに　神羅の悪行の歴史を
伝えなきゃならないからな

English.Text: Not about to let Shinra scrub the world and its shameful history clean.

Text:
岬の灯台　なんでも屋とかいう
店になってたんだとよ

English.Text: So that rando up in the lighthouse? Was a merc who thought to set up shop.

Text:
あんなところに
お店開いたんですか？

English.Text: Seems like a dumb place to do that.

Text: はは　儲かりそうにはないよな

English.Text: Haha! Yeah, that's what I said.

Text:
まあ　貴重な文化遺産が
無事でなによりだ

English.Text: But they left the place as they found it, so s'all good.

Text: 青年団の同志よ　調子はどうだい？

English.Text: Hey there, fellow freedom fighter. How goes it?

Text:
ここはサイドジュノンだ
疲れてるなら休んでいくといい

English.Text: Welcome to the Crow's Nest! Feel free to rest up here if you need to.

Text:
モンスターが荒れてる
気をつけろよ

English.Text: Keep a sharp eye out for monsters.

Text: 青年団の同志よ　無事を祈る

English.Text: Farewell, fellow freedom fighter─and stay safe!

Text: はい　歴史の授業を始めますね

English.Text: Okay, everyone. Who's ready to learn some history?

Text:
むかしむかし
ジュノンには大きな船をつなげて作った
海の上の街がありました

English.Text: Our republic's capital, Junon, was built on top of giant ships that floated just offshore.

Text: ジュノンと神羅は　戦争になりました

English.Text: But many years later, Shinra started a war...

Text: 戦争は　神羅が勝ちました

English.Text: A war that Shinra ended up winning.

Text:
負けたジュノンは
海に沈んでしまいました

English.Text: And then they sank our beautiful, floating city.

Text: 神羅は　海の底に魔晄炉を作りました

English.Text: Shinra then built a giant underwater reactor.

Text:
魔晄の影響で
お魚さんは死んでしまいました

English.Text: But the reactor's mako started killing the creatures of the sea!

Text:
みんなのお母さん　お父さんは
みんなが大きくなるまえに
神羅と戦わなければならないの

English.Text: The mako hurts creatures on land too. And if we don't act fast, it'll even start hurting us.

Text:
みんなが　お魚さんみたいに
ならないように

English.Text: That's why we have to work together to stop Shinra.

Text:
ここの生活は楽じゃないと思うけど
がまんしましょう

English.Text: So never forget, children, that the ocean is counting on you.

Text: じゃあ　みんなで復唱ね

English.Text: And what do we always say?

Text: 泣きません　海が青く戻る日まで

English.Text: No tears until our waters are crystal clear.

Text: 泣きません　海が青く戻る日まで

English.Text: No tears until our waters are crystal clear!

Text: はーい！

English.Text: Okay!

Text: 泣きません　海が青く戻る日まで

ウータイの連中が
なんかやったんだって？

English.Text: Heard Wutai's makin' moves against Shinra!

Text:
いよいよ俺たちの時代が来るな
気合い入るぜ

English.Text: It took a while, but our time's finally come! Let's do this, people!

Text:
反神羅グループを結ぶ連絡会
マジであったのか！

English.Text: There're people going around connecting anti-Shinra forces? Since when!?

Text:
反神羅連絡会の同志って
ここにもいるのかしら

English.Text: Hey, do you think there are any undercover SRC reps in our area?

Text:
暴力反対！
荷物をまとめて逃げ出さなきゃ

English.Text: I'm so outta here. War is not what I signed up for.

Text:
戦争じゃなくて
豊かな海を取り戻したいだけなのに

English.Text: I don't want a war. I just want an ocean that doesn't stink of mako.

Text: いいか　みんな聞いてくれ！

English.Text: People of the Crow's Nest, listen!

Text:
俺たちの故郷　ジュノンの海
本当の色を覚えているか

English.Text: Look at our ocean! Look at it! What do you see!?

Text:
昔はな　真夏の青
どこまでも澄んでいたんだ

English.Text: I'll tell you what you see! The green taint of Shinra's poison!

Text:
それがいまじゃ
魔晄で汚染され　生態系は乱れ
大切な魚もとれなくなった

English.Text: This poison has ruined our seas! Destroyed their beauty! Left them as barren as Corel's desert!

Text: ぜんぶ　神羅が悪いんだ！

English.Text: And is Shinra gonna answer for this crime!?

Text:
仕方ないとあきらめるのか
いいや　俺たちはあきらめない！

English.Text: No! Not unless we make them! Not unless we hold them to account!

Text:
ああ　俺たちは
もういちど豊かな海を取り戻したいと
立ち上がった

English.Text: We're here for one reason, and one reason only: to rid our waters of everything Shinra!

Text:
心血を注ぎ　ビラを配り
街頭で署名を募った

English.Text: So we pound the pavement. Get the word out. Make the people mad as we are!

Text:
だが　俺たちの活動を受けても
神羅はなにも変わらない

English.Text: But we know how Shinra operates. Our anger alone won't be enough to drive them out!

Text:
それはなぜか
わかるよな　みんな！

English.Text: And while I know that this is painful for us to admit...

Text: まだ　俺たちの力が足りないからだ

English.Text: We Crows lack the strength to topple their might!

Text:
もっと同志を集めよう
署名も　もっともっと必要だ！

English.Text: So we have to galvanize the people, collect more signatures! Post more flyers!

Text:
豊かな海を取り戻したいという
想いがあるのなら
どうか　力を貸してほしい

English.Text: If we want to restore Junon's waters to their brilliant blue, then we cannot rest for even a moment!

Text:
共に戦おう
ジュノンの豊かな海を取り戻そう！

English.Text: We can win this fight if we stand tall and stand together! Who's with me!?

Text: いいか　みんな聞いてくれ！

English.Text: Hear me─all of you!

Text:
俺たちが夢見た　神羅カンパニーとの
戦いの日が近づいている

English.Text: This is the moment we've been dreaming of! Shinra's day of reckoning!

Text:
いまこそ
俺たちの想いを振り返るときだ

English.Text: Now is the time to remind ourselves why we fight!

Text: おう！

English.Text: Yeah!

Text: なんだ！

English.Text: Tell 'em!

Text: なんだ～！

English.Text: What's up!?

Text: 聞くぜ！

English.Text: We hear ya!

Text: おう！

English.Text: Woo!

Text: なんだ！

English.Text: Preach!

Text: なにさ！

English.Text: Hell yeah!

Text: なんだ～！

English.Text: We're listening!

Text: そうだそうだ！

English.Text: Damn straight!

Text: ああ！

English.Text: Yeah!

Text: そのとおり！

English.Text: Exactly!

Text: 異議なし！

English.Text: You know it!

Text: よし！

English.Text: Alright!

Text: そうだそうだ！

English.Text: It's about time!

Text: そのとおり！

English.Text: You said it!

Text: 異議なし！

English.Text: You know it!

Text: うおおお！

English.Text: Yeah!

Text:
わあ　チョコボファーム？
牧場主さん　どこかな

English.Text:
Well, look at that: another chocobo ranch!
I wonder where the owner's hiding.

Text: 見ない顔だな　沼を越えてきたのか

English.Text: Who're you? Wait...you didn't come from the grasslands, didja?

Text:
はい　グリン牧場のお世話になって
なんとか

English.Text:
Yeah, we did. You know Bill?
He helped us cross the swamp and everything.

Text: まったく　グリンのやつ

English.Text: He what? Goddammit...

Text:
チョコボの沼渡りは危険だから
あの看板は外せと言ったのに

English.Text: I told that idiot to take his signs down... Swamplands're dangerous, even on chocoback.

Text: 俺はここの牧場主の　ガボンだ

English.Text: I'm Gabe, by the way. Owner of the ranch here.

Text:
最初に断っておくが
チョコボの貸し出しはしとらんよ

English.Text: And before you ask, my birds are not for rent. Ain't worth the risk.

Text: 運送の仕事は　神羅の規制が厳しくてね

English.Text:
Used to run deliveries,
but Shinra put the kibosh on all that.

Text:
それでも　のらりくらりと営業してきたが
ついに荷車が壊れたんだ

English.Text:
Still tryin' to keep it goin' best I can...
Well, was tryin', till my carriage shit the bed.

Text:
修理のための部品もなくて　万事休す
俺もチョコボも　心が折れちまった

English.Text: And since I don't have the parts to fix her, both she and my business are as good as dead. Even the chocobos're feelin' down about it all.

Text: 修理　手伝いましょうか？

English.Text: You know, I bet we could help you fix it.

Text: いやあ　もういいんだ

English.Text: Kind of you to offer, but nah.

Text: 部品があれば　直りますよね

English.Text: It's just a matter of getting the right parts, isn't it?

Text:
それはまあ
でも　こんな状態でな

English.Text: Says the girl who ain't gotta fix it. But even if ya were some kinda secret grease monkey...

Text: 報酬を出す　余裕がないんだ

English.Text:
I wouldn't be able to pay ya for your time.
I'm flat broke.

Text:
何度か放したが　戻ってくるんだ
いまさら野生には戻れないのさ

English.Text: Curious about my birds? I've tried settin' 'em free, but they just keep comin' back. Force of habit.

Text: こうなっては　仕方がない

English.Text: Well, nothing for it now.

Text:
俺が責任持って
あいつらといっしょに　朽ちていくよ

English.Text:
Serves me right, thinkin' I could run a business.
Shoulda known it'd all fall apart.

Text: そんなの　責任じゃないと思います

English.Text:
Hey, come on now.
Don't be so hard on yourself!

Text:
ねえ　お願い
チョコボとわたしに　ちから貸して？

English.Text:
Please, Cloud─he needs help.
If not for him, then at least for the chocobos?

Text: チョコボとわたしに　ちから貸して？

English.Text: Offer to help Gabe?

Text: どうしたんだ

English.Text: Why're you so adamant about this?

Text: だが……

English.Text: I dunno...

Text: 引き受ける

English.Text: Yes.

Text:
もしかすると　自己満足
でも　見過ごせないの

English.Text:
Maybe I just wanna feel like I...did a good deed.
But look at him. And his birds!

Text: おねがい～

English.Text: Pretty, pretty please?

Text: ありがと！

English.Text: Sweet!

Text: 話が進んでいるが

English.Text: I wasn't really askin', but...

Text:
修理用の部品の調達は大変だぞ
このあたりじゃ　手に入らない

English.Text: I gotta warn ya─the parts I need are hard to come by. At least, around here they sure are.

Text: どこにあります？

English.Text: So where can we get them?

Text:
山の上の小屋に　職人がいる
だが　小屋までは山登り用のチョコボが必要だ

English.Text:
From this craftsman at the top of the mountain.
He'll have 'em. Can't go on foot though. Only a certain chocobo can make that climb.

Text: ベルってのが　その辺にいるはずだが

English.Text:
Bird by the name of Belle.
Last I saw, she was over yonder.

Text: そのチョコボなら　もういます

English.Text: She certainly was, but now she's with us!

Text: ほう

English.Text: That so?

Text: 捕まえるのは　難しいぞ

English.Text: And she ain't a big fan of people.

Text: では　しゅっぱつ！

English.Text: Alright, let's roll!

Text: 期待しないで待ってるよ

English.Text: Curious to see how this all turns out.

Text:
山の上のオヤジは　変わり者だ
ムカついたら負けだぞ

English.Text: You mind your manners around that fella on the mountain, or he's liable to kick ya off it.

Text: クエ　クエ～！

English.Text: Kweh, kweh!

Text: ごめんね　報酬もないのに

English.Text: Sorry for roping you into this even though he can't pay.

Text:
なあ　エアリス
弱々しく見せていたが　あの男は強いと思う

English.Text: Not can't─won't. Hate to break it to you, but...pretty sure that guy's better off than he looks.

Text:
もしかして　わたし　だまされた？
うまく使われてる？

English.Text:
Wait─seriously? Are you saying I got duped?
That he's just using me?

Text: かもしれない

English.Text: 'Fraid so.

Text: くう～

English.Text: That jerk...

Text:
でも　チョコボのため
がんばるぞ　おう！

English.Text:
Whatever. I'm not doing it for him anyway.
I'm doing it for the chocobos!
Zzz...

Text: ぐう……ぐう……

English.Text: Zzz...

Text: むむ……むう……

English.Text: Hrm... Hng...

Text: う～ん　なんだあ？

English.Text: Can I help you?

Text: ガボンの荷車を　直したいんだ

English.Text: We're trying to fix Gabe's cart.

Text: ああ　部品か

English.Text: Ah, so you're looking for parts.

Text:
じゃあ　明日か明後日に来てくれ
いまは眠くて眠くて……

English.Text: Well, you'll have to come back tomorrow─or the day after. I'm too tired to help ya right now.

Text: どうする　叩き起こすか

English.Text: Think a swift kick'd get him up?

Text: 寝たフリの職人を……

English.Text: What will you do?

Text: 優しく起こす

English.Text: Wake him gently.

Text: 魔法で叩き起こす

English.Text: Wake him with magic.

Text: 無視して帰る

English.Text: Leave him be.

Text:
もしも～し　起きてくださ～い
ねえ　お願い

English.Text:
Rise and shine! Get up, sleepyhead.
C'mon! Please?

Text:
うう～ん　心地のいい声だ
スリプル並みだな

English.Text:
The voice of an angel...
I'm gonna dream sweet dreams tonight...

Text: 起きなさい！

English.Text: Wake up!

Text: おい　本気か！

English.Text: Whoa! You're not serious, are you!?

Text: おっかねえなあ

English.Text: Scared me half to death.

Text: 帰ろっか

English.Text: Forget it.

Text: なんだよ　さみしいねえ

English.Text: You're leaving? But you just got here!

Text:
オレを動かしたいなら
そのメモを見て　ぜんぶ集めてくるんだな

English.Text: You wanna get my ass up? Then you bring me exactly what's on that list, got it?

Text: どうする？

English.Text: Well?

Text: やる　ぜったい

English.Text: I say we get his ass up.

Text:
うん……？
メモを見て　必要なモン集めてこいよ
持ってきたぞと！

English.Text: Special delivery!

Text: うん……？

English.Text: Hrm?

Text: 集めたアイテムを渡しますか？

English.Text: What will you do?

Text: 持ってるだけ渡す

English.Text: Hand over the goods.

Text: 部品について聞く

English.Text: Ask about the part.

Text: 渡さない

English.Text: Nothing.

Text:
うん……？
メモを見て　必要なモン集めてこいよ

English.Text:
What? Didn't you read the list?
Everything I need's written right there.

Text: ああ？　持ってねえじゃねえか

English.Text: This some kinda joke? You ain't got nothin'!

Text: ふ～ん　ケチったなあ

English.Text: Thought I said everything on the list...

Text: ほう　まあまあだな

English.Text: I guess I can make do with this.

Text: おお　大盛りか！

English.Text: Oho! Now that's what I'm talkin' about!

Text:
ふわ～あ　オレはブレディ
で　なんの用だって？

English.Text:
Anyway, name's Freddie.
So what was it ya needed again?

Text: なんの用だって？

English.Text: What was it you needed?

Text: ここでなにを？

English.Text: To ask what he's doing.

Text: 戦争について

English.Text: To ask about the war.

Text: ガボンについて

English.Text: To ask about Gabe.

Text: 荷車の部品が欲しい

English.Text: To ask for the part.

Text: なにって　具体的にはなにも

English.Text: Frankly, I'm not doin' much of anything.

Text:
ただ　戦争のことを思うのさ
ここは戦争中　防空壕として使われてたんだ

English.Text: Other than thinking about the war, that is. This used to be a shelter, y'know. One of the few safe spots during the air raids.

Text: 市民も兵士も　大勢が犠牲になった

English.Text: Lotta folks lost their lives─good, decent folks.

Text:
生き残ったオレにできるのは
静かに寄り添ってやることくらいさ

English.Text: Can't bring back the dead, but...least I can do is sit here and pay 'em my respects.

Text: 共和国と神羅の戦争だよ

English.Text: Junon versus Shinra. Before your time.

Text: あちこち　壊れた建物が残ってただろ

English.Text: Ya didn't think all those buildings demolished themselves, didja?

Text: オレは　共和国の兵士だった

English.Text: Anyway, I fought in the republic army.

Text:
最後のほうは　そりゃひどいもんだった
オレたちは無残に負けて　このザマさ

English.Text:
And let's just say it wasn't pretty...
Got our asses handed to us, and what you see now is all that remains.

Text: ガボンとは　まあいわゆる戦友だ

English.Text: Gabe and I? We go way back. Comrades in arms.

Text:
あのオッサンも昔は
チョコボ騎兵隊のエースだったんだぜ

English.Text: You'd never know it now, but he used to ride front and center in the chocobo cavalry.

Text:
ふたりで山の中を駆けまわって
何度も神羅に奇襲を仕掛けてな

English.Text: We scoured every inch of these mountains─huntin' for Shinra units and attackin' 'em when they least expected it.

Text: いま思えば　ずいぶん無茶をしたもんだ

English.Text:
Had some close calls too.
Dunno how we survived.

Text:
お互い　じゅうぶん過ぎるほど戦った
これからは　静かに隠居生活でも送るつもりさ

English.Text: We fought tooth and nail for ourselves and the republic, but...wasn't enough. Now I'm just hoping to live out the rest of my days in peace.

Text: ああ　そういや　そんな話だったな

English.Text: Oh, yeah. You did mention that.

Text: ちょっと待ってろ

English.Text: This'll just take a sec.

Text: ほら　できたぞ

English.Text: Tell me she ain't a beauty.

Text:
オレにしか作れねえ頑丈なやつだ
好きに持ってけ

English.Text:
Nobody makes 'em like I do, and that's no lie.
Go on─take it.

Text:
もっと　作っておいてください
ガボンさん　きっと来るから

English.Text: You oughta make more than that. Gabe's definitely gonna need 'em at some point.

Text:
どうだか
まあ　気が向いたらな

English.Text: I dunno about that. 'Sides, I've got things to do.

Text:
ふわ～あ……
用が済んだなら　帰った帰った

English.Text:
Like catching some Z's, for one.
So, if we're all done here...

Text:
用が済んだら　長居は無用
生き急げ若人よってな

English.Text: Best be on your way if you don't need to hassle me for anything else. This old dump's no place for the young.

Text: ガボンが待ってんだろ

English.Text: 'Sides, Gabe's waitin'.

Text:
ガボンがチョコボで来るようになったぜ
また商売っ気出しやがって

English.Text:
Y'know, Gabe swung by the other day.
Said he's "back in business," that old dog.

Text:
見まわりの時間だ
こいつらが安らかに眠れるようにってな

English.Text: I'm just doing my usual rounds, making sure these good folks can rest in peace.

Text:
墓も風化して壊れちまうんだ
直してやらねえとな

English.Text:
The wind and rain take a toll on these graves.
Gotta patch 'em up every now and then.

Text:
ブレディさんから
いいもの　お届けです

English.Text: Guess what! Brought you a present from your good friend Freddie.

Text: ほう

English.Text: Is that so...?

Text:
荷車　ちゃんと直して
チョコボ　大切にする？

English.Text: Only if you promise to fix your carriage and take better care of your chocobos.

Text:
うん？　まあ仕方ねえな
ああ　やるよ

English.Text:
Well, twist my arm, why don't ya.
Alright, little lady─it's a deal.

Text: じゃあ　いますぐ　始めてくださいな

English.Text: Good. In that case, no time like the present.

Text: ふう　できた……

English.Text: Phew, good as new.

Text: まあ　こんなもんだろうな

English.Text: Well...almost.

Text: クエ～……

English.Text: Kweh...

Text: なかなか　悪くない

English.Text: Or close enough, I suppose.

Text: ブレディのやつ　まだまだ衰えてはいないようだ

English.Text: Guess Freddie hasn't lost his touch─even after all these years.

Text: クエッ！

English.Text: Kweh!

Text:
おお　ブレディのやつ　ずいぶんはりきったな
申し分のない　立派な荷車だよ

English.Text: I gotta say, that old dog really outdid himself this time. Helluva job. Don't think my carriage has ever looked even half this good!

Text: クエ　クエ～！

English.Text: Kweh, kweh!

Text: ありがとうな　これでいつでも運送業に戻れるよ

English.Text:
'Preciate it, kids. I can finally get
the business back up and running again.

Text:
よかった　じゃあ帰るまえに
ひとつ　質問

English.Text:
That's great. But before we head out,
I just wanna ask one more thing.

Text:
わたしたち来なかったら
チョコボ　ずっとあのままだった？

English.Text: If we hadn't shown up, would you have even tried to give your birds a better life?

Text: かもな

English.Text: Maybe.

Text: そっか

English.Text: I see.

Text:
でも　神羅カンパニー怖いから仕方ないよね
口出しされたら逆らえないし

English.Text: But I get it. Shinra's a big company─and what they say goes. I can't blame you for being too scared to fight back.

Text: そりゃ違う　神羅にビビったりはしねえよ

English.Text:
Hey! I ain't scared of those sons of bitches.
Not one bit.

Text: じゃあ　どうして　お仕事やめたの？

English.Text: Oh? Then why'd you shut down the business?

Text:
そりゃあんた　荷車が壊れちまって
直すにも部品の調達が面倒だし

English.Text: It's like I told ya─my carriage broke. And getting the parts to fix it sounded like a real hassle, so...

Text: おう　ようするに面倒だったんだよ

English.Text: So there ya have it! I just...let it go.

Text: めんどうだった？

English.Text: How responsible.

Text:
わかった　俺が悪かった
全面的に悪かった

English.Text: Okay, fine. I shouldn't've been so quick to throw in the towel. Ya happy?

Text: これからは　仕事に精を出すよ

English.Text: Starting today, I'm giving this job my all.

Text:
部品もストックして　すぐに直せるようにするし
チョコボの世話もちゃんとする

English.Text: I'll stock up on parts so I can keep the carriage moving, and make sure my birds never get bored again.

Text: 聞いたよね

English.Text: You hear that?

Text: クエッ！

English.Text: Kweh!

Text: では　よろしく

English.Text: Then the deal is sealed!

Text: 姉ちゃんにはかなわねえなあ

English.Text: You're quite the businesswoman yourself.

Text: なあ？

English.Text: Ain't she?

Text:
チョコボに愛想尽かされないように
しっかりしねえとな

English.Text: Don't wanna ruffle that bird's feathers any more than I already have...

Text:
ブレディのところにも
そのうち顔を出さなきゃな

English.Text: Probably oughta drop by Freddie's place at some point too.

Text:
ブレディとは
昔は戦友　いまは昼寝友達よ

English.Text:
Freddie and I are "war buddies."
Well, more like "snore buddies" these days.

Text:
神羅に見つからん抜け道も　まだまだあるぞ
険しい道だが　チョコボの健康にはいいな

English.Text: We discovered all sorts of secret paths, safe from Shinra's prying eyes. Not the easiest trails, but they keep the birds in shape.

Text: 腰痛とんでけ　肩こりとんでけ

English.Text: Wish I could say they kept me in shape, but, well... Those roads do a real number on my back.

Text: ガボン牧場のチョコボ運送だよ～！

English.Text: Gabe's Chocobo Express!

Text: お届け物の到着だ

English.Text: Special delivery comin' in!

Text: おう！

English.Text: Here ya go.

Text: 持ってけ持ってけ

English.Text: Don't drop it now!

Text: 荷物の依頼はあるか？

English.Text: Do ya need something delivered?

Text: チョコボで配達するよ

English.Text: We'll get it there in a flash!

Text: まかせとけ

English.Text: You got it.

Text: 置いてけ置いてけ！

English.Text: Just leave it right there!

Text: よ～し　出発！

English.Text: Alright, giddyup!

Text: チョコボ運送におまかせあれ

English.Text: Your package'll make tracks when ya send it on chocoback!

Text:
ガボンさんが仕事を再開したと聞いて
飛んできました

English.Text: I flew right on over here when I heard Gabe was back in business!

Text:
遠方へおでかけでしたら　ぜひ
ガボン牧場のチョコボ車をご利用ください

English.Text: If you're in the market for a ride, Gabe's chocobos will get ya where you need to go lickety-split!

Text: チョコボ車のご利用ですか？

English.Text: So─need a lift somewhere?

Text: 今日は絶好のチョコボ日和ですね

English.Text: Nothing beats a ride in a bird-drawn carriage!

Text: ガボンさんに負けないよう　僕も働きますよ！

English.Text: No one works harder than Gabe, but I sure try!

Text: またのご利用を

English.Text: Another time!

Text: そうですか

English.Text: Okay then...

Text: どうぞ　お気をつけて

English.Text: Stay safe out there!

Text: チョコボショップは　元気に営業中です！

English.Text: Business is booming at our one-stop fashion shop!

Text:
どうも
チョコボのグッズ　見ていきます？

English.Text: Howdy! Care to give our wares a once-over?

Text: ガボンさん　やる気出してくれないかなあ

English.Text: Sure hope Gabe starts pulling his weight soon...

Text: チョコボ　かわいがってあげてくださいね

English.Text: Give that bird a pat on the head for me, will ya?

Text: ガボン牧場　チョコボショップで～す！

English.Text: We got everything ya need to get your bird lookin' spiffy!

Text: チョコボ～！　いらっしゃいませ～

English.Text: Kweh-lcome! How can I help you?

Text: チョコボ～！　ばいば～い

English.Text: Choco-bye-bye for now! Come back soon!

Text: ありがとうございました～

English.Text: Thankweh kindly!

Text: なんだい　まだウロウロしてたのかい

English.Text: Huh. Didn't think you'd still be hangin' around...

Text:
しばらくこのあたりにいる気なら
ひとつ　おつかいでも頼もうかね

English.Text: Well, since you clearly don't have anything better to do, think I could put you to work?

Text: 懸賞金の残りを　ある場所まで届けたくてね

English.Text:
The remainder of your bounty─
I need it delivered to someone.

Text: 届け先は　この子が知ってる

English.Text: I've already got a porter picked out too.

Text: コハダっていうんだ

English.Text: This here's Salmon.

Text:
あんたたちの仕事は
コハダのボディガードってところだね

English.Text:
Since he'll be the one makin' the drop,
it's your job to get him there safe.

Text: ワン！

English.Text: Woof!

Text:
引き受けてやってもいいが
誰に届けるかくらい　聞かせてもらおうか

English.Text:
Doesn't seem like too much of a hassle,
but...who exactly is this money for?

Text: 息子だよ

English.Text: My son.

Text:
しばらく会っちゃいないけどね
勝手に村を出てって　それっきり

English.Text: Haven't seen him in a spell, not since he left town...and never looked back.

Text: この金は　手切れ金ってとこさ

English.Text: This gil's me washing my hands of him.

Text:
もう　子供って歳でもないし
いい加減　独り立ちしてもらわないとね

English.Text: He's a grown man. Can't be clingin' to his mom's skirts─or her pocket book.

Text: 依頼を引き受けますか？

English.Text: What will you do?

Text: 息子はどこにいる？

English.Text: Ask where her son is.

Text: 手切れ金とは？

English.Text: Ask about the money.

Text: 引き受けよう

English.Text: Take the job.

Text: サイドジュノンだよ

English.Text: The Crow's Nest.

Text:
日陰の暮らしに飽きただの
私のやりかたは　生ぬるいだの

English.Text:
Boy got sick of living under this steel sky...
and my thumb, I suppose.

Text:
そういう連中が寄り集まって
ジュノンのはずれで　活動してんのさ

English.Text: So he went into the mountains way east of here. Found some more like-minded idiots.

Text:
ったく　家出するならするで
もっと遠くに行けばいいのにさ

English.Text: Kinda sad, if I'm being honest. If you're gonna run away, at least go somewhere interesting.

Text: 中途半端ったらないよ

English.Text: Don't half-ass it.

Text:
文字どおりの意味だよ
私は村のことで　手いっぱいだからね

English.Text: I meant what I said. Can't afford to take care of this town and his shit.

Text:
ここまで育ててやりゃ　もうじゅうぶんだろう
あとは勝手にどこへなり行ってもらおうと思ってさ

English.Text: I raised him best I could─gave him every advantage. But he's gotta learn to stand on his own two feet.

Text:
それに私にはこの子もいるしね
ねえ　コハダ

English.Text: 'Sides, I've got someone else to take care of now... Don't I, Sam?

Text: ワン！

English.Text: Woof!

Text: じゃ　よろしくね

English.Text: Much obliged.

Text:
報酬は向こうにいるトビーって男から受け取ってよ
手配しといたからさ

English.Text:
Once you make it to the Crow's Nest, find Toby.
He'll make sure you get the reward I promised.

Text:
いいかい　コハダにケガなんかさせたら
報酬から差っ引くからね

English.Text:
But if I find a single hair outta place on Sam,
you won't live to enjoy it.

Text: ちゃんと　守っておくれよ

English.Text: You keep my boy safe.

Text: ワン　ワン！

English.Text: Woof woof!

Text:
コハダになにかあれば
今度こそ　神羅に突き出すよ

English.Text: Got Shinra on speed dial, so if my dog gets hurt, you get hurt.

Text:
なるべく早く済ませてほしいんだ
スッキリしたいからね

English.Text:
You mind hurrying it along?
I just wanna put this whole business to bed.

Text: ワン　ワン！

English.Text: Woof woof!

Text: コハダについていきますか？

English.Text: Follow Salmon?

Text: はい

English.Text: Yes

Text: いいえ

English.Text: No

Text: ワン！

English.Text: Woof!

Text:
おう　ちゃんと守ってやっから
心配すんな

English.Text: Don't you worry. Any monster that wants to getcha is gonna have to go through me!

Text: バウバウッ！

English.Text: Bow wow!

Text:
よう　クラウド
おまえはいつ　家を出たんだ

English.Text:
Hey, Cloud, remind me.
How old were you when ya left home?

Text: １４……いや　春だからまだ１３だ

English.Text: Fourteen. Wait, it was spring, so...thirteen.

Text:
田舎じゃあ　そんなもんだな
母ちゃんはどう言ってた？

English.Text: Suppose that ain't too unusual for small-town boys like you. What'd your mom have to say?

Text:
反対はされなかった
それくらいで村を出るのは普通だったからな

English.Text:
Not much─didn't try to stop me.
Like you said, nothing unusual about it.

Text: ああ……

English.Text: But...

Text: なんだ？

English.Text: "But"?

Text:
２０００ギルくれたんだ
新生活には　それくらい必要だとか言って

English.Text:
Two thousand gil─she offered me that.
"To make a fresh start."

Text: ロドナーんちと同じじゃねえか

English.Text: Guess moms're the same all over.

Text:
俺は断った　軍に直行だったから
必要なかった

English.Text: I turned the money down, though. Didn't need it, since I was planning to enlist straightaway.

Text:
ははははは！
おまえが２０００にこだわる謎が解けたぜ

English.Text: But you still can't help settin' your price at two grand. Sentimental, ain'tcha!

Text: なあ　聞けよ

English.Text: Okay, hear me out.

Text: 聞いてる

English.Text: What?

Text: 子供の独り立ちを邪魔する親がいるだろ

English.Text: Know how some parents stop their kids from leavin' the nest?

Text:
まだ早いとか　甘いとか
なんだかんだ理由つけてよ

English.Text: Claimin' it's too soon, or they're not ready─any excuse to keep 'em at home.

Text: いるのかもな

English.Text: What about it?

Text:
いるんだよ　でもオレは
そうはならねえって心に決めてるんだ

English.Text: Loads of parents're like that, but I told myself I'd be different─I'd never keep my little girl from flyin'.

Text: マリンの独立心を尊重してやりてえ

English.Text: I don't wanna clip her wings─I want her to soar!

Text: ふん

English.Text: Heh.

Text:
笑ったな　鼻で笑い飛ばしたな？
オレには無理だとか思ってんだろ

English.Text:
I hear you scoffin'. You think I can't do it.
You think I'll keep her all to myself!

Text: まあな

English.Text: Oh yeah.

Text:
そうなんだよ　心に決めてはみたものの
ぜんぜん　できる気がしねえ

English.Text: And that's what scares me! As much as I wanna let her fly, I dunno if I'll be able to let go when the time comes.

Text:
マリ～ン　マリ～ンって
しがみついて邪魔する気がする

English.Text: Maybe I'll panic─get in her way, hold her down, all to keep her safe!

Text: はあ　マリン……

English.Text:
Oh, Marlene, I wish you could be
my baby girl forever...

Text: ああ　マリン……

English.Text: Oh my sweet, baby girl...

Text: 今度はなんだ

English.Text: What now?

Text: 父ちゃん　父ちゃんは……

English.Text: Your daddy... Your silly daddy... He's gonna...

Text: がああああ　やっぱ無理だーーー！

English.Text:
He's gonna fail you! Oh, I can't let you go.
I just can't!

Text:
落ち着けバレット
マリンが家を出るにしても　まだずっと先だ

English.Text:
Barret! Get your shit together.
Marlene's barely outta diapers. You've got time!

Text: だよな　そうだよな

English.Text: Right, right...

Text:
そうそう想像　ただの想像
まだまだ先の話だ

English.Text:
I'm just gettin' worked up over nothin'! Yeah!
She won't be leavin' me for a while!

Text: たぶんな

English.Text: Then again...

Text: おい！

English.Text: Hey!

Text:
ここはサイドジュノン
オレたち　反神羅青年団の拠点だ

English.Text: This here's the Crow's Nest, base of operations for our anti-Shinra activities.

Text:
悪いけど　いまはアンダージュノンで騒動があって
通せないんだ

English.Text: Sorry, but we're keeping things locked down after the trouble in Under Junon.

Text: ここは通せないよ

English.Text: Can't let you through.

Text:
ごめんなさい
この先は立ち入り禁止です

English.Text: Sorry, sweetheart. No visitors allowed.

Text:
ここはサイドジュノン
あたしたち　ここで反神羅活動してるのよ

English.Text: Up ahead's the Crow's Nest, where our brave resistance fighters come home to rest and regroup.

Text: いまはちょっと　ゴタゴタしててね

English.Text: Although it's a little hectic right now...

Text: この先は立入禁止よ

English.Text: I'm gonna have to ask you to leave.

Text: ワン　ワン！

English.Text: Woof woof!

Text: コハダ！　どうしてここに

English.Text: Sam? What're you doing here?

Text: 傷だらけじゃないか　いったい誰に……

English.Text:
And you're hurt!
You come all this way alone?

Text: ワフン　ワフン！

English.Text: Arf arf!

Text:
つらかったな
うん　よく我慢した

English.Text: Poor boy... It's okay, you're safe now.

Text: なんなんです

English.Text: Who're you?

Text:
ちょっと疲れてるか？
ここまで遠かっただろ

English.Text:
Aw... You must be beat, buddy.
Coming all this way just to say hi.

Text: ワン！

English.Text: Woof!

Text: あれ　あなたたちは？

English.Text: Uh, do I know you?

Text:
はは！
相変わらず元気いっぱいだな　おまえは

English.Text: Came all this way and you're still full of energy!

Text: ワン　ワン！

English.Text: Woof woof!

Text: あれ　あなたたちは？

English.Text: Uh, do I know you?

Text:
あんたの母ちゃんに雇われた
コハダのボディガードだ

English.Text:
We're Sam's bodyguards.
Your mom hired us to keep him safe.

Text: 母ちゃんからあんたに　おこづかいだってよ

English.Text: And to make sure her boy got his allowance.

Text: ワン！

English.Text: Woof!

Text:
母からの荷物なら受け取れません
俺　家出中なんで

English.Text:
Keep it─I ain't takin' her money.
I can make ends meet on my own.

Text: ディラン　お客さんなの？

English.Text: Who're they, Dillan? Friends of yours?

Text:
クレア　出てきたら危ないだろ！
転んでケガでもしたら……

English.Text:
Claire, what're you doing out of bed!?
You know you need to stay off your feet.

Text:
とにかく　これは受け取れません
コハダといっしょに　お引き取りください

English.Text: I know you came all this way, but I can't accept that. Just make sure Sam gets home safe for me.

Text:
がんこなとこは母ちゃん譲りってか？
ったく　しゃあねえなあ

English.Text: You really are your mother's kid. Got her stubbornness and everything. Have it your way.

Text: これは　あんたに預ける

English.Text: Why don't you hang on to it?

Text: えっ　こんなに！

English.Text: This is a fortune!

Text: どうしてもって言うなら　返してもいい

English.Text: If ya really don't want it, I'll take it off your hands.

Text: でも　赤ん坊が生まれるまで待て

English.Text: But as a parent, I'm sure you wanna give your kid the best life ya can.

Text: 親になれば気持ちが変わる　たぶんな

English.Text:
And in my experience, that don't come cheap.
Think it over.

Text: 親になれば……

English.Text: That's true...

Text: ワン　ワンワン！

English.Text: Woof! Woof, woof!

Text: わかりました

English.Text: We'll take it.

Text: ワオーン！

English.Text: Awoo!

Text: ディラン　ここにいたのか

English.Text: Dilster! Was lookin' for ya, dude!

Text: トビー

English.Text: Toby?

Text: 遅くなってすみません

English.Text: Sorry, got a little tied up.

Text:
アバランチのみなさんですよね
ロドナーさんから　話は聞きました

English.Text:
Hang on─aren't these guys with Avalanche?
Rhonda said I might run into you!

Text:
アバランチ？
まさかあの魔晄炉爆破を成功させた？

English.Text: Avalanche? Wait─you mean they're the ones who blew up those reactors?

Text:
そう　まさに僕たちの希望の星！
いやあ　お目にかかれて光栄です～

English.Text:
The superstars themselves! I just wanna say,
it is such an honor to meet you.

Text:
実は　みなさんに折り入って
お願いしたいことがありまして

English.Text:
Actually, while you're here,
think I could ask you for a favor?

Text:
ディランの件は　え～っと
いちおう解決したんですかね

English.Text:
Seein' as Dillan's, uh, "situation"
seems to be taken care of?

Text: おう　バッチリだ！

English.Text: Yep. S'all good.

Text:
ということでしたら　さっそく
僕の話も聞いていただけると助かります

English.Text:
Excellent! In that case,
why don't we step into my office for a chat?

Text: どうぞ　中へ！

English.Text: Right this way!

Text: 母さんはこの子のこと　知っていたんでしょうか

English.Text:
You think my mom knew about me and Claire?
And the baby?

Text:
生まれてきたら
ばあちゃんに会いに行ってみるか？

English.Text:
Once you're outta there,
we'll go pay your grandma a visit.

Text:
生まれてくる子供のためにも
俺たちの海を取り戻さないとな

English.Text:
These used to be our waters, y'know.
And they will be again someday.

Text:
聞こえてるか？
父さん　頑張るからな

English.Text: You hear that? Daddy's gonna make you proud.

Text:
聞きましたか　反神羅連絡会の演説！
クレアと子供のためにも　俺は戦いますよ

English.Text: You hear that speech from the SRC? Got me all fired up! I'm ready to fight for my family and their future.

Text:
もう　ビラ配りなんかしてる場合じゃないぞ
まずは武器を集めないと！

English.Text:
Handin' out flyers ain't gonna cut it anymore.
It's time to take up arms!

Text:
アバランチの方とのご縁
この子が繋いでくれたのかもしれませんね

English.Text:
I'm happy we were able to meet you.
Almost feels like this little one brought us together.

Text:
私たちも　反神羅を掲げてはいますが
思うように活動できていない状況で

English.Text:
We despise Shinra just as much as you do,
but with a baby on the way, it's hard to offer aid to the resistance.

Text:
この子のためにも　アバランチのみなさんとは
力を合わせて行けたらと思ってます

English.Text: Still, if there's anything we can do to ensure a brighter future for our child, just say the word.

Text:
もう　ディランったら……
やる気なのはいいけど　無茶はしないでね

English.Text:
My husband's got spirit, I'll give him that.
I just hope he stays out of trouble.

Text:
この子の名前も　そろそろ考えないとね
お義母さんにも相談できたらいいのだけど

English.Text: We really ought to start thinking of names for the baby. Would be nice if Rhonda could give us a few suggestions, but...

Text:
こんなタイミングで戦争だなんて
どうなっちゃうのかしら　私たち

English.Text:
War's no good for anyone...
I just pray we get through this. All of us.

Text:
大丈夫よ
あなたのことは私が必ず守るわ　大丈夫

English.Text: Don't worry. No matter what happens in this crazy world, Mommy's gonna keep you safe. I promise.

Text:
ちょっと　コハダだけ先に帰すなんて
どういうつもりだい

English.Text: Hey! What were you thinking, sending Sam back alone like that!?

Text:
ワンコに聞けよ
そいつは　スタンプ以上だぜ

English.Text: He even need us in the first place? Your mutt'd give Stamp a run for his money.

Text: それで　あの子は元気にしてたのかい？

English.Text: So...how's my son? Seem okay?

Text: ああ

English.Text: Yeah.

Text: 腹んなかのガキもな　知ってたんだろ

English.Text: You gonna stand there and pretend this wasn't all about Claire and her bun in the oven?

Text:
ったく　なにが手切れ金だ
意地張りやがってよ

English.Text: Psh... Apple didn't fall far from this stubborn-ass tree, that's for damn sure.

Text: ふん　なんのことだか

English.Text: Hmph, wouldn't know about that.

Text: じゃあ話は終わりだ　世話になったね

English.Text:
And if you're done makin' wisecracks,
I got work to do.

Text:
よ～しよしよし
おつかい　えらかったねえ

English.Text: You did a good job today, boy... Someone's gettin' extra pets.

Text:
男の子かねえ　女の子かねえ
こんな楽しみなことってあるんだね

English.Text: Do you think it's gonna be a little boy, or a little girl? I bet you can't wait to find out, either, can ya, Sam?

Text:
おや　また来たのかい
たいした用もないだろうに　ヒマだねえ

English.Text: Back again? Figured people like you had better things to do than watch the paint dry in a place like this.

Text: まあ　好きなだけいればいいさ

English.Text: Not to say we don't enjoy the company.

Text:
なんだいしつこいね
私はヒマじゃないんだ　早く行きな

English.Text: What─just feel like pokin' the bear? 'Cause I do have things to do. Unlike some.

Text: ロドナーさんは　どうするつもりなんだ

English.Text: What the hell's Rhonda gonna do about all of this?

Text: 当然　神羅と戦うんでしょう？

English.Text: She's gonna take the fight to Shinra, that's what!

Text:
ワシらだって　まだまだやれるぞ！
海で鍛えた体をナメてもらっちゃあ困る

English.Text: And when she does, we join her! We're people of the sea─rough waters don't scare us!

Text:
このまま泣き寝入りなんて
あたしゃゴメンだよ！

English.Text: If Shinra thinks we'll take this lying down they got another thing comin'!

Text:
グレン大佐の演説以来　この調子でね
見張りもまともにできやしないよ

English.Text: Thanks to that Lodbrok guy and his little speech, the town's so riled up I can't get a moment's peace...

Text:
反神羅連絡会……
まえにいちど　ここへも来たことがあったよ

English.Text: Y'know, that Shinra Resistance Committee or whatever came here to try 'n' recruit once.

Text: そのときは　追い返したけどね

English.Text: Shooed 'em away as quick as I could.

Text:
サイドジュノンの連中が
無茶を起こさなきゃいいけど

English.Text: Might've just sent 'em straight into the powder keg that is the Crow's Nest though.

Text:
ミッドガルでのみなさんのご活躍
ニュースで見た時は　胸がスッとしましたよ～！

English.Text: Man, you Midgarinos are somethin' else. When I saw you on the news, I was blown away!

Text:
いや～　アバランチの方々に
力を貸してもらえるなんて　本当に夢みたいです

English.Text: And here you are, lendin' me a hand! It's literally a dream come true!

Text:
実はですね
岬にある灯台が　いつのまにか

English.Text:
So, here's the situation.
There's this big lighthouse down by the cape...

Text:
『なんでも屋ジュノン支店』とかなんとか
よくわからない人に　乗っ取られてしまいまして

English.Text: And someone calling themselves "the Merc of Junon" has turned it into their hideout or something.

Text: キリエだな

English.Text: Kyrie...

Text:
あれ？
もしかして　お知り合いでしたか

English.Text: Oh. Are they an...acquaintance of yours?

Text: まあな

English.Text: Sorta.

Text:
なんという偶然
いや　これはもう必然というべきですね

English.Text: What are the chances!? I dunno about you, but I think fate brought us together.

Text: なんでも屋？

English.Text: A "merc"?

Text:
あれ？
もしかして　お知り合いでしたか

English.Text: Oh. Are they an...acquaintance of yours?

Text: いや……

English.Text: No...

Text:
あの灯台は　もともと僕たちが
物見台として使っていた場所なんです

English.Text: Anyway, that place has got a killer view. We used to go up there all the time and just chill.

Text:
最近は　モンスターも増えてて危ないし
はやく立ち退いてもらいたくて

English.Text: But it's too dangerous with all the monsters around, and that merc hasn't done a thing about 'em.

Text:
みなさんのお力で
どうにか　説得してもらえませんかね

English.Text: So I was hoping you could do me a solid and convince that merc to help us out.

Text: 依頼を引き受けますか？

English.Text: What will you do?

Text: なんでも屋とは？

English.Text: Ask about the merc.

Text: 灯台はどこにある？

English.Text: Ask about the lighthouse.

Text: 引き受けよう

English.Text: Do him a solid.

Text:
ミッドガルやグラスランドで大活躍していた
とのことなんですが

English.Text: They've done many a good deed in Midgar and all throughout the grasslands.

Text: ど～も　うさんくさくて

English.Text: Allegedly, that is.

Text:
だいたい　なんでも屋ってなんなんですか
聞いたこともないですよねえ

English.Text:
And, like, if they're so good at "doing good,"
then why aren't they doing anything now?

Text: 灯台は　この先の岬にあります

English.Text: The lighthouse is up ahead, right on the cape.

Text:
もともとは　共和国時代の航海で……
って　それはまあいっか

English.Text: Apparently, it used to guide ships back in the republic days, but that was, like, forever ago.

Text: とにかく辺鄙な場所だし　モンスターも出るし

English.Text:
Anyway, it's super outta the way
and crawling with monsters.

Text:
あんなところでお客を募っても
誰もこないですよ　ぜったい！

English.Text:
Anyone who thinks customers'll come calling
is outta their mind.

Text:
ありがとうございます
みなさんの手腕　拝見させていただきます

English.Text: Yo, you're the best! Y'know, I just knew I could count on you.

Text: 誰か　いっしょに――

English.Text: So? You gonna help, or...?

Text: 私か？
えっ　オイラ？

English.Text: Wait─me?

Text: トラブルのにおいがするんだ

English.Text: You can sniff out trouble.

Text: ならば　私が適任だろうな

English.Text: I suppose that does make me the most suitable candidate.

Text:
まかせて！
オイラ　厄介事を解決するのは得意なんだ

English.Text: You've got that right. Leave it to me! My nose always knows the right way to go.

Text:
ああそうだ　もしお時間があれば
丘のほうにも寄ってみてください

English.Text:
Oh, pro tip! If you ever get the chance,
you oughta swing by the hill too.

Text:
運が良ければ
コンドルの姿が見れるかもしれませんよ

English.Text:
You might even catch a glimpse of
the great condor if you're lucky!

Text: 興味があれば　ぜひ

English.Text: If you're into that kinda stuff.

Text:
アバランチの方達と　こうしてお会いできるなんて
夢にも思わなかったな～！

English.Text: Never in my wildest dreams did I think I'd end up becoming best buds with Avalanche!

Text:
灯台は　この先の岬です
どうぞお気をつけて

English.Text: The lighthouse isn't far─it's right on the cape. Be careful out there!

Text: ずいぶんと派手にやっているようだな

English.Text: "Tacky" would be an understatement.

Text:
うわ～　すごく目立ってるね
これならぜったい道に迷わないよ

English.Text: Wow, someone really splurged on their advertising budget. Least they'll never have trouble finding the place!

Text: キリエ……

English.Text: Kyrie...

Text: この商売根性は　尊敬に値するな

English.Text: They certainly poured their energy into the promotional aspect.

Text:
へへ　このヤル気満々な感じ
オイラ嫌いじゃないよ

English.Text:
Gotta say, their passion's impressive.
I actually kinda dig it!

Text: キリエは中か　行くぞ

English.Text: They'll be thrilled to hear it. Let's go.

Text: よく来たな

English.Text: Greetings.

Text:
おれがなんでも屋の　キリエだ
報酬は――

English.Text: Kyrie, Merc of Junon. And you are?

Text:
って　なんだあ
お客さんじゃなくて　ウチの社員じゃん

English.Text: Aw, man. And here I got all excited thinking I had a customer...

Text: こんなところまで出張　ごくろうさまでーす

English.Text: Well, thanks for makin' the trip out here to say hi, fellow merc.

Text: 社員になった覚えはない

English.Text: Not your "fellow" anything.

Text:
勝手に　なんでも屋を名乗るな
いますぐここから立ち去れ

English.Text:
And quit calling yourself a merc.
You're giving the real ones a bad name.

Text: えっうそ　クラウド？

English.Text: Oh my gosh. Cloud!?

Text:
キリエ……
ここでなにをしている

English.Text: Kyrie... What the hell are you doing here?

Text:
あ～　ちょっとしたビジネス？
おばあちゃんとケンカしちゃってさ

English.Text: Um...just a little business venture? Grandma went off on another one of her tirades.

Text:
ミッドガルの外でガッツリ稼いで
見返してやろうと思って
