English.Text: I swore to myself I'd make a killing outside the city so I could rub it in her face!

Text:
あっそうだ　クラウドもここで働く？
歓迎するよ　新入社員くん

English.Text: Ah, I've got it! Why don't you come work for me? I could use another merc, and you're not half bad.

Text: 社員になるつもりはない

English.Text: Not in a million years.

Text:
勝手に　なんでも屋を名乗るな
いますぐここから立ち去れ

English.Text:
And quit calling yourself a merc.
You're giving the real ones a bad name.

Text: あ～　いっぺんに言われてもわかりませ～ん

English.Text: What even is a merc? Nobody really knows!

Text:
それに　元はといえば
ぜ～んぶ　クラウドのせいなんだから

English.Text: And besides─arguably this whole mess can be laid at your feet, mister.

Text:
せっかくジュノンにまで進出したっていうのに
だ～れも　なんでも屋さんのこと知らないんだもん

English.Text: I came all the way out to Junon to strike it rich, but nobody knows we're here...or even that we exist!

Text:
知名度ゼロ　仕事の依頼もゼロ
ホント　まいっちゃってさ～

English.Text:
Zero publicity, which means zero clients!
I mean, this is Business 101!

Text:
仕方ないから　わたしがこうして
大々的に宣伝してあげてるってわけ

English.Text: Since you suck so bad at self-promotion, I had to pick up the slack and come up with an ad campaign.

Text: じみ　くらっ　ぶあいそ

English.Text: what's your brand? Tall, blond, and "not interested"?

Text: そんなんじゃ　廃業まっしぐらだよ

English.Text: Sounds like a one-way ticket to bankruptcy to me.

Text: ……すまない

English.Text: Ahem... Allergies.

Text: あっ　ごめん

English.Text: ...Sorry.

Text: うわ　なにこの子　しゃべれるの？

English.Text: What!? Shut. Up. This thing can talk!?

Text: よろしく

English.Text: Indeed.

Text: 獣がしゃべったら　ダメなの？

English.Text: Uh, is that a problem?

Text: うわ～　すっごい　かっわい～！

English.Text: Aw, aren't you just the most adorable boy!

Text: ねえキミ　わたしのペットにならない？

English.Text: Hey─y'know, I've always wanted a pet of my own!

Text: ほら　おいで～

English.Text: C'mere─come to mama!

Text: ううう　こわっ！

English.Text: ...Yikes!

Text: ざんねん……

English.Text: Okay, scratch that.

Text:
残念といえば　こんなに頑張ってるのに
いまだにお客さんゼロでさ～

English.Text: Right! Anyway, as I was saying, I'm putting in all this work for us, yet we haven't managed to bring in a single customer!

Text:
このままじゃ　なんでも屋の社長兼
宣伝部長の名がすたる！

English.Text: And if we don't get one really soon, your CEO and PR head is as good as done!

Text:
ってことで　さっそく
こんなのも用意してみたんだよね～

English.Text: But not to worry! I put my creative skills to work and came up with this ditty!

Text: なんでも屋　なんでも屋 新装開店　なんでも屋～♪

English.Text: There's a new merc─a new merc in town She's, like, the best─the best around♪

Text: なんでもやります　なんでも屋～♪

English.Text: She's open for business, so come on down♪

Text: いえ～い！
どうどう　宣伝効果バツグンでしょ？

English.Text: Pretty good, right? Folks'll be lining up in no time!

Text:
えっ　うそ
モンスター呼んじゃった？

English.Text:
Wait, monsters!?
But what could've drawn them here?

Text: おそらく　この不愉快な音のせいだろうな

English.Text: I'm sure your aggressive advertising has nothing to do with it.

Text: たぶん　この音のせいだよ

English.Text: Really? You're kidding, right?

Text:
なんでも屋さん　お願い！
モンスター退治　得意だよね

English.Text: Please, Cloud! You gotta help me! After all, nobody knows how to take down monsters like a merc.

Text: なんでも屋なら　自分でなんとかしろ

English.Text: So hire yourself. You're a pro, aren'tcha?

Text:
そう言わずに～！
あっほら　これあげるから

English.Text:
C'mon, don't be petty...
Oh! I'll even give you some of these!

Text: いらない

English.Text: Pass.

Text:
クラウド　このままでは我々も危険だ
行くしかない

English.Text: Wait─our lives are in as much danger as hers now. We have to fight.

Text:
クラウド　行こう
このままじゃ　オイラたちも危ないよ

English.Text: But if we don't stop those monsters, we're all done for. C'mon!

Text:
ほら　なんでも屋さん
よそ見してないで　もっと働いて！

English.Text: C'mon, get rid of those things already, wouldja!? I thought you were supposed to be good at your job!

Text:
あっ　油断してたでしょいま
気をつけてよ～？

English.Text: I saw you take that hit, y'know! And they call you the pro? Psh!

Text:
こんなやつら
なんでも屋さんなら楽勝だよね～

English.Text: These losers oughta be easy pickin's for a merc like you!

Text:
いいねえ　さすが自慢の社員
その調子その調子～！

English.Text: Cleave 'em in two, my loyal subordinate! Wish I could film this; it'd make for a great commercial!

Text:
ま～だで～すか～？
待ってるのも飽きたよお

English.Text: Okay, tick tock, tick tock! The boss's gettin' bored and she's not payin' you to have fun out there!

Text: はあ　助かった～

English.Text: Whew! Glad that's over.

Text:
こんなモンスターウジャウジャな場所じゃ
そりゃ　お客さんなんてこないか～

English.Text: And now I know why I wasn't getting any customers: nobody could get past all those uglies.

Text: 学びがあって良かったな

English.Text: I'm glad you learned something.

Text: 最初から　わかりそうな気もするけど

English.Text: I'm surprised it took you this long to figure it out.

Text: 仕方ない　ここでの営業はあきらめるとしよう

English.Text:
Oh, well...
Guess I'll just have to close up shop and clear out!

Text:
じゃあわたし　もう行くから
あと片付けよろしくね　社員くん！

English.Text: Anyway, I'm gonna split, but I'm sure you can take it from here. Catch ya later, fellow merc!

Text: おい

English.Text: Hey!

Text: いっしょにくる？　ほら　おいで～

English.Text: Wanna leave with mama? C'mon, you know you do...

Text: じゃね～！

English.Text: Okay, later!

Text: 距離を置きたい種類の人間だ

English.Text: I wouldn't wish her on my worst enemy.

Text: オイラ　あの人ちょっとニガテかも

English.Text: Gotta say, somethin' about her really rubs me the wrong way.

Text: 同感だ

English.Text: You and me both.

Text: みなさ～ん！

English.Text: My dudes!

Text:
変な放送が聞こえて外を見たら
モンスターがウヨウヨ移動してて

English.Text:
I saw the monsters headed your way...
and couldn't help but worry...

Text:
いや～でも　心配無用でしたね
さすが　アバランチのみなさん！

English.Text: but it looks like I worried for nothing. I should've known Avalanche could hold their own!

Text: それで　なんでも屋さんはどうなりました？

English.Text: Out of curiosity, what happened to that merc?

Text: 出ていった

English.Text: She moved on.

Text:
そうですか
じゃあ　ここは片付けなくちゃ

English.Text:
Bummer. Welp, guess we should
get this place cleaned up.

Text:
それよりロドナーさんから聞きましたよ
みなさんも　なんでも屋をやってるって！

English.Text: Oh yeah, Rhonda was telling me you do merc work on the side too. For real?

Text:
いや～　最初から言ってくれればいいのに
水くさいなあ

English.Text:
I can't believe you didn't say anything!
Best buds don't keep secrets, y'know.

Text: なにかあったら　また力を貸してくださいね

English.Text:
But I hope you'll lend me a hand
the next time I need help!

Text:
アバランチに　なんでも屋ですか
いや～　僕たちももっと頑張らないとですね

English.Text: Avalanche by day, traveling mercs by night. I dunno how you dudes find the time to do it all!

Text:
この灯台は封鎖しておきます
また誰かが迷い込んだら　危ないですし

English.Text: Feel like we should probably rope this place off. Don't want anyone else wandering inside and making trouble.

Text:
お時間があれば
丘のほうにも寄ってみてください

English.Text:
If you ever get the chance,
you oughta swing by the hill too.

Text:
運が良ければ
コンドルの姿が見れるかもしれませんよ

English.Text: You might even catch a glimpse of the great condor if you're lucky!

Text:
ようこそ　サイドジュノンへ
みなさんなら　いつでも大歓迎です！

English.Text: Hey there! Goes without saying, but you dudes are always welcome here at the Crow's Nest.

Text: なんでも屋のお仕事は順調です？

English.Text: How's business? Making bank?

Text:
そうだ　今度ここで勉強会を開いてくださいよ
報酬は弾みます

English.Text: Say, you should do a seminar or something─teach us how to fight the power. Stick it to the man!

Text:
あっ　みなさん
なんだか　急に騒がしくなっちゃいましたねえ

English.Text: Hey there, buds. Things've gotten pretty crazy lately, huh? What a world!

Text: 僕も絶賛　情報収集中です

English.Text: Almost too much to keep track of─but I try!

Text:
みなさんは　連絡会とは繋がってないんですか？
ご存知のことがあれば　教えてくださいよ

English.Text: Hey, uh, you wouldn't happen to know anyone in the SRC, would you? If you do, I'd kill for an introduction!

Text:
おお　お客さんかな？
今日は良い風が吹いておるのう

English.Text:
Oho! Care to join us, young lady?
We've got a lovely breeze blowing today.

Text:
ほんとに　みなさん
ここでなにをしてるんですか？

English.Text:
You certainly do.
So...what're you all looking at?

Text: どでかいコンドルの観察じゃ

English.Text: We're on the lookout for the great condor.

Text:
ここからやつの様子を眺めて
定期的に健康状態を確認しとるんじゃよ

English.Text:
We try to catch sight of it every time it takes flight─
make sure it's in good health and all that.

Text:
あやつは悪いやつじゃないが
腹をすかせれば　獲物を襲う

English.Text:
It's not really a danger to people,
but its hunger can drive it to hunt larger prey.

Text: 人が襲われたりしたら　大変じゃからの

English.Text: Let's just hope it never develops a taste for us!

Text: 『安全第一　コンドル予報』

English.Text: Surely you've seen our newsletter, haven't you?

Text:
ワシらの発行してるかわら版じゃが
見たことあるじゃろ？

English.Text:
It's filled with fun facts about our beloved bird.
I'm quite proud of it.

Text: コリンさん

English.Text: Sir...

Text:
今日はもう　現れそうにないです
そろそろ部屋に戻りましょう

English.Text:
I don't think the condor is going to show today.
Maybe we should head back.

Text: いや　もうすこしだけ待たせてくれ

English.Text: No, let's wait a little longer, lad.

Text:
ここんところ姿を見てないから
どうも　心配でのう

English.Text:
That bird's got me a bit worried.
Haven't seen it in a fair while now...

Text: やっぱり　エサを用意しておくべきでしたかね

English.Text:
I wonder if we should've given it
something to eat after all.

Text:
うむ　いちおう
掲示板にも依頼を出してはみたんだが

English.Text:
Perhaps. I put a post up on the
noticeboard asking for help, but...

Text:
そういうことなら
私たちが　お力になれると思います

English.Text:
Well...if you're still looking for volunteers,
we'd be more than happy to help.

Text: おお　それは願ってもない申し出だが

English.Text:
Well!
Far be it from me to turn down such an offer...

Text: 依頼を引き受けますか？

English.Text: What will you do?

Text: コンドルとは？

English.Text: Ask about the condor.

Text: 『助けられた』とは？

English.Text: Ask how he was saved.

Text: エサについて

English.Text: Ask about the feed.

Text: 引き受けよう

English.Text: Accept his request.

Text:
ここからそう遠くない孤島にすまう
雄大で　美しい鳥だ

English.Text: It's a grand old bird. Makes its nest on a small island just a stone's throw from here.

Text: ワシは若い頃　やつに助けられたことがあっての

English.Text:
Even saved my life back when I was a lad,
if you can believe it.

Text:
礼というわけでもないが　こうして観察を続け
生態を研究させてもらってるんじゃ

English.Text: The condor was looking out for me that day, so I thought I should start looking out for it─keep tabs on its well-being and whatnot.

Text:
戦争中　敵に追われて迷い込んだ森で
足をすべらせてな

English.Text: Back during the war, I was running from some Shinra troopers when one of 'em got me in the back. I fell to the ground...

Text:
動けなくなったワシを　コンドルが
近くの村まで運んでくれたんだ

English.Text: I thought I was done for─until that bird snatched me up and flew me to the next town over.

Text: ほほっ　エサと間違えただけかもしれんがな

English.Text: I sometimes wonder if it mistook me for its supper.

Text: あの時のケガで　ワシの足は動かなくなったが

English.Text: I never managed to regain the use of my legs, unfortunately.

Text:
ここでコンドルを眺めていると　ワシも
大空を駆けているような心地になれるんじゃよ

English.Text: But I feel my spirit soar when I watch that condor fly. I may be stuck here, but at least they're still free.

Text:
あのコンドルは　プライドが高くてのう
人間が用意したエサなど　滅多に食べることはない

English.Text: It's a proud creature─a hunter at heart. We've tried to feed it before, but it seems to prefer catching its own prey.

Text:
だが　いいニオイがすれば
近くまで様子を見にくるくらいはするはずじゃ

English.Text: If something smelled enticing enough, though, it might be moved to come and take a closer look, I suspect.

Text: ありがたい　助かるよ

English.Text: Thank you. I appreciate it.

Text:
この先の森に
コンドルが好きな狩り場があります

English.Text:
One of the condor's favorite hunting spots
is in the woods nearby.

Text:
エサを探しに向かうなら
山登りが得意なチョコボが必要ですよ

English.Text: You'll need a chocobo that can manage the climb to get there. It's...pretty tough.

Text:
チョコボなら　牧場のあたりにいるはずじゃ
探してみておくれ

English.Text: There should be a chocobo trotting around the ranch somewhere. Maybe have a look over there.

Text:
姿を見せずとも
元気にやっているのならいいのだが

English.Text: I can't help but feel disappointed when I don't see it for a time─and a little worried...

Text: エサのことは　よろしく頼んだよ

English.Text: You'll find something tasty for it, won't you?

Text: 見て　あそこ

English.Text: Look─over there!

Text: いまのが　コンドルの好物か？

English.Text: There goes the condor's dinner.

Text: ニオイ　残ってないかな

English.Text: Maybe we can track its scent.

Text: クエッ！

English.Text: Kweh!

Text: クエッ　クエ～！

English.Text: Kweh, kweh!

Text: チョコボに嗅がせてみるか

English.Text: A chocobo could track 'em...

Text: クエッ！

English.Text: Kweh!

Text: クエッ　クエクエ！

English.Text: Kweh, kweh, kweh!

Text: この先みたい

English.Text: Guess it's in here.

Text: 行ってみよう

English.Text: Let's go.

Text: どうしよっか

English.Text: What do we do now?

Text: <button=RS> 持って帰るエサを選ぼう

English.Text: <button=RS> Choose an Item to Take

Text: 動物の肉

English.Text: Bovine Meat

Text: モンスターの肉

English.Text: Monster Flesh

Text: ナゾの野菜

English.Text: Peculiar Greens

Text: いちおう　あれだけでも持っていく？

English.Text: What about those? Better than nothing, right?

Text: 戻ったか　手間をかけたな

English.Text:
Oh, you're back!
Hope it wasn't too much trouble.

Text: あちらの高台に　エサを置いてあげてください

English.Text: You can put the food right over there. Thank you.

Text:
おお　これは立派な肉だ
コンドルも　たまらず降りてくるかもしれん

English.Text: This is quite the cut of meat! I've no doubt the bird will be unable to resist the call of such fine dining.

Text:
ずいぶん変わった色の肉だな
いったい　なんの肉なんだ？

English.Text:
I've never seen meat of that particular color.
Are you sure it's safe for condor consumption?

Text: あれは　野菜か？

English.Text: Are those...greens?

Text:
う～む　ヤツが野菜を食べるところなど
見たことはないが……

English.Text: Hmm, I can't say I've ever seen it feast on anything except meat, but...

Text:
やっぱり　好きだな
見あげれば空って

English.Text:
Gotta say, it's kinda nice─
looking up and seeing a blue sky.

Text: 首を痛めないように　気をつけろ

English.Text: Beats a steel one, that's for sure.

Text:
でも　届かないものに手を伸ばすのって
ちょっと怖いね

English.Text: Though at least with a steel sky you know your limits. Out here...it's endless.

Text: エアリスは　こんな気持ちなのかな

English.Text: I kinda get what Aerith was saying now.

Text: そうかもな

English.Text: Yeah, maybe.

Text: 見て　あそこ！

English.Text: Hey, look!

Text: すごい　こんなに近くまでくるなんて

English.Text: What a sight... I never dreamed I'd be able to see it up close like this!

Text:
ああ……いかん
写真　写真じゃ　急げ！

English.Text:
Wait! We have to get a photograph!
Grab the camera!

Text: はっ　はい！

English.Text: Yes, sir!

Text: おお　シャッターチャンス！

English.Text: C'mon. Gather round, everyone!

Text: ほれ　はよせい！

English.Text: Quickly, quickly!

Text: とっ　撮ります！

English.Text: Say cheese!

Text: いい写真　撮れましたか？

English.Text: So, snap any good shots?

Text:
わたし　びっくりして
緊張しちゃって

English.Text:
I hope so... It just showed up!
I could barely hold my camera, and...

Text: でもこれ　とてもいい写真だと思います

English.Text: Really? Couldn't tell from a shot like this.

Text: ほほっ　我ながら子供のような顔をしとるわ

English.Text:
Hahaha. Why, I haven't looked this happy
since I was a lad.

Text:
たまーに　こんな奇跡が起こるから
コンドルの観察はやめられんのかもしれんなあ

English.Text: It's precious moments like these that make condor-watching so exhilarating! You never know what to expect.

Text:
さあ　今日の記録をまとめたら
さっそく次の観察会の準備をせねば

English.Text: Well, scouts, let's finish writing up today's report and start preparing for our next fateful encounter!

Text: はい！

English.Text: Sir!

Text: 次こそはうまく撮れるよう　写真の練習もな

English.Text: And hopefully next time we'll be able to snap a clearer picture of that bird!

Text: はい！

English.Text: Sir!

Text:
あの　良かったらこれ
記念にどうぞ

English.Text: Miss? I'd like you to have this─as a souvenir.

Text: クラウド　顔！

English.Text: Nice face, Cloud.

Text:
君たちのおかげで　すばらしいものが見られた
感謝しておるよ

English.Text: We haven't had a sighting like that in who knows how long─and it's all thanks to you.

Text: あの写真は　大事にとっておくとしよう

English.Text: Y'know, I ought to get a nice frame for that photograph.

Text:
もう　肝心な時に私ってば
昔からこうなんです　私

English.Text: I blew it again─just like I always do! I really am nothing but a colossal failure.

Text:
次こそは　このレンズで
コンドルの姿を捉えてみせます！

English.Text: But that ends today! Next time, I'm gonna snap the perfect shot!

Text:
あんなに間近でコンドルを見たのは
僕も初めてです

English.Text: I've never had the privilege of seeing a condor up close like that before.

Text: まだ心臓がバクバクしていますよ

English.Text: My heart is still pounding!

Text: でも　あんなところまで降りてくるなんて

English.Text: Although it's strange for the condor to come this far down...

Text:
もしかしたら　モンスターのせいで
コンドルのエサも減ってきているのかもしれません

English.Text: I'd hate to think fiends have been messing with its food supply. Poor bird's got enough problems...

Text: ゲコゲコ！

English.Text: Ribbit!

Text: わっ　カエル？

English.Text: Ah! Uh...hello?

Text:
おじさんたち　だれ？
ここは子供以外　立入禁止だよ

English.Text: Hey, what do you think you're doing here? This is a no-grown-up zone─get lost!

Text: 人間……

English.Text: You're a kid!?

Text: あたりまえ！

English.Text: Well duh!

Text:
海底魔晄炉の影響かわかんないけど　なんでか
ここでだけ　カエルに変身しちゃうんだ

English.Text: It's just how this place is. I dunno if it's 'cause of the reactor out there or what, but hangin' out here turns you into a frog.

Text:
フィン　それだれ？
神羅じゃないよな

English.Text: Hey Finn, who're they? Not Shinra, I hope...

Text: ああ　ちがうちがう

English.Text: Oh no, we're definitely not.

Text:
もしかして　プリシラが言ってた人たち？
村で助けてもらったって

English.Text: Oh, wait─you must be the ones Priscilla was talking about. She told me how you saved her!

Text:
ああ　プリシラ！
そうそう

English.Text: Right, that's us! We're friends.

Text: プリシラとは　仲良しなの？

English.Text: Are you a friend of hers too?

Text: べつに　ただの幼馴染みってだけだ！

English.Text: We're friends─but it's not like I like her or anything!

Text:
村の子供は　そんなに多くないし
仲良しってほどじゃ……

English.Text: It's just, there aren't a lotta other kids in the village, so I basically had to be her friend!

Text: 了解　了解

English.Text: Of course.

Text: きみたち　こんなところでなにをしてるの？

English.Text: So what're you kids doing all the way down here?

Text: なにって　『フロッグフラップ』だよ

English.Text: Uh, playing jumpfrog─obviously.

Text:
いっしょに遊ぶ仲間を探してたんだ
せっかくだし　お姉さんたちも遊んでく？

English.Text: Actually, we could use a couple more players. Since you're here, do you wanna give it a try?

Text: きゃあああ！

English.Text: Aaah!

Text: 助けて！

English.Text: Help us!

Text: うん！
行こう　クラウド！

English.Text: C'mon, Cloud!

Text: うそっ！

English.Text: What the hell!?

Text: うそっ！

English.Text: What the hell!?

Text: ティファ！

English.Text: Tifa!

Text:
言ったじゃん！
この入江は　カエルに変身しちゃうって

English.Text: I tried to warn you! Like I said: hangin' out here turns you into a frog!

Text:
でも　おじさん達なら
カエルになっても　余裕でしょ？

English.Text: But don't worry. All you gotta do is start thinkin' like a frog and you'll be fine!

Text: そんな……

English.Text: Oh great...

Text: そんな……

English.Text: Oh great...

Text: 楽勝だ

English.Text: We got this!

Text:
『フロッグフラップ』　いっしょに遊びたければ
あのモンスターを倒しちゃってよ

English.Text: You guys're never gonna get to play jumpfrog with us if you don't do something about those gross monsters first!

Text: ありがとう！

English.Text: Thanks for that!

Text:
じゃあ　今度こそ『フロッグフラップ』
いっしょに遊ぼう！

English.Text: So, ready to play? C'mon, you'll love it. I promise!

Text: また？

English.Text: Again!?

Text: まいったな

English.Text: Again...

Text: じゃあ　ルールを説明するね

English.Text: Okay! Here are the rules:

Text: どう　できそう？

English.Text: Think you two can handle it?

Text: 『フロッグフラップ』で遊びますか？

English.Text: Play jumpfrog?

Text: はい

English.Text: Yes

Text: いいえ

English.Text: No

Text: ホッピングコンパス

English.Text: Whirligig Whack

Text: ローリングパイプ

English.Text: Ribbiting Rollers

Text: やめる

English.Text: Quit

Text:
あれ～　やらないの？
オタマジャクシにもなれないね

English.Text: You're not even gonna play? You made me explain the rules for nothing!?

Text: あれ～　やらないの？ オタマジャクシにもなれないね

English.Text: You're not even gonna play? You made me explain the rules for nothing!

Text: つまんな～い

English.Text: Grown-ups are boring.

Text: つまんな～い

English.Text: Grown-ups are boring.

Text: えっ　もしかしてカエルになるのイヤとか？

English.Text: Aw, what's the matter? Scared you won't change back?

Text: えっ　もしかしてカエルになるのイヤとか？

English.Text: Aw, what's the matter? Scared you won't change back?

Text: まあ　カエル初心者ってとこかな

English.Text: Everyone's gotta start somewhere, I guess...

Text: 反応が鈍いよ～　もっとゲコゲコやらなきゃ

English.Text: Do people always become bad at games when they get older or something?

Text: 反応が鈍いよ～　もっとゲコゲコやらなきゃ

English.Text: Do people always become bad at games when they get older or something?

Text: あ～あ　もっとゲコっといこう！

English.Text: You gotta think like a frog!

Text: おっ　いい感じにカエルだね

English.Text: Huh. That wasn't half bad!

Text: うんまあ　ゲコ具合は悪くないね

English.Text: You've still got a little room to grow, but you'll get there.

Text: ゲコゲコ～って　調子出てきた

English.Text: You seem like you're gettin' the hang of it, at least.

Text: カエル　似合ってる～ 思ってたよりやるじゃん

English.Text: Y'know, you make a pretty good frog! For a grown-up, that is.

Text: ばっちりゲコってるね　スゲー！

English.Text: Wow, you've got some serious hops!

Text: さっすが～　もしかしてカエル名人？

English.Text: This isn't your first time turning into a frog, is it?

Text: どうする　もうちょっとやってく？

English.Text: So, do you wanna go another round?

Text: どうする　もうちょっとやってく？

English.Text: So, do you wanna go another round?

Text: どう　なかなか面白いでしょ？

English.Text: Whaddya think? It's pretty fun, right?

Text: ふん　まあな

English.Text: Meh, I've played worse.

Text:
いろいろ　あんがとね
また　いつでも寄ってってよ

English.Text: Anyway, thanks again for your help! You can come back again if you want.

Text: クラウド　楽しそうだったね

English.Text: You looked like you were having fun.

Text: ティファもだ

English.Text: Ribbit.

Text: ちょっと　クセになりそうかも

English.Text: I could get used to it.

Text: それは　勘弁してくれ

English.Text: Yeah...I wouldn't go that far.

Text: ゲコゲコ！

English.Text: Ribbit ribbit!

Text: あっ　おい！

English.Text: Hey!

Text: ゲコゲコゲコ！

English.Text: Ribbit ribbit ribbit!

Text: また　カエルで遊んでく？

English.Text: Wanna get hoppin' again?

Text: せっかく来たんだから いっしょに遊んでってよ！

English.Text: You can't drop by and not play a round with us!

Text: 大人は大変そうだけど　おれたちには関係ないし 遊べるうちに遊ばなきゃ！

English.Text: The grown-ups are all freaking out, but who cares? Jumpfrog's where it's at!

Text: こういう時こそ　ゲコっと行こう！

English.Text: No better time to croak it up!

Text: 下に注意しろ

English.Text: Watch the water!

Text: 下から狙ってやがる！

English.Text: Keep your eyes on the water!

Text: 下だよ　気をつけて！

English.Text: It's right under us!

Text: えっ　泳いでる？

English.Text: Back in the water, huh?

Text: 潜られたか

English.Text: It's below us.

Text: いまがチャンスだ

English.Text: Now's our chance!

Text: 一気に叩き込む！

English.Text: Let's finish this!

Text: 隙アリだ　撃ちまくってやる！

English.Text: Alright! Let's pump it full of lead!

Text: 叩きのめしてやらあ！

English.Text: Time to fillet this fish!

Text: チャンスだよ！

English.Text: Ready!?

Text: チャンスは逃がさない！

English.Text: You're not getting away!

Text: このまま決めよう

English.Text: We gotcha now!

Text: せめて　一気に！

English.Text: Now you're in for it!

Text: 一気に決めるぞ！

English.Text: Time to end this!

Text: 好機を逃すな

English.Text: Don't waste this opening!

Text: 必ず助ける

English.Text: Hang on!

Text: すぐ助ける

English.Text: I'll get you out.

Text: すぐ助けっから　待ってろよ！

English.Text: Just sit tight! We got you!

Text: すまねえ　すぐ助ける！

English.Text: Stay calm! Help's comin'!

Text: すぐに助けるから！

English.Text: Hold tight, okay!?

Text: 待ってて　すぐ助ける！

English.Text: You'll be out before you know it!

Text: ここは　わたしにまかせて！

English.Text: We'll get you outta there!

Text: えっ　うそうそ！

English.Text: Crap!

Text: 助けよう

English.Text: Don't worry!

Text: あきらめるな

English.Text: I'm coming!

Text: 魔法を試すか……

English.Text: Shit. Better off with magic.

Text: くそ　魔法ならいけっか？

English.Text: A spell or two oughta speed things up.

Text: ダメ？　なら　魔法で！

English.Text: Spells will get the job done quicker!

Text: 魔法の出番？

English.Text: Time for some magic!

Text: 牙は効かぬようだな……

English.Text: Neither fang nor claw will suffice.

Text:
兄ちゃん
あの人なら勝てるんじゃない？

English.Text: Hey, look. I bet we could beat him!

Text:
勝てるかもしんないけど
金は持ってなさそうだな

English.Text: Yeah, probably. But I don't get the feeling he's got any money.

Text:
いいか　バウトが弱そうで
金を持ってそうなヤツを探すんだ

English.Text: Remember: we're not just looking for rookies; we're looking for rich rookies.

Text:
バウトに勝って
お駄賃をもらうんだよね！

English.Text: Uh-huh! Then we can make 'em pay up when we win!

Text:
お兄さん　もしかして
バウトする相手を探してる？

English.Text: Oh, hey there, mister! Are you looking for someone to play Queen's Blood with?

Text: だったら　おれたちが相手しようか

English.Text: We'd be more than happy to go a round or two with you!

Text: ぼくは　弟のデ・ムーア

English.Text: I'm Devin, the younger brother.

Text: おれは　兄のダ・ムーア

English.Text: And I'm Darren, the older one.

Text:
ふたりあわせて『ツインズのムーア』！
双子のカードバウターだよ

English.Text:
And together, we're the Double D Duo!
A team of twins who love Queen's Blood!

Text:
まずは弟と戦って
勝てたら　おれと勝負できるよ

English.Text:
You'll face my little brother here first.
If you win, then I'll take you on.

Text: いちどで２戦できて　すっごくお得なんだ

English.Text: Two for the price of one! Sweet deal, right?

Text:
その代わり　ぼくたちのどちらかに負けたら
３ギルもらうからね！

English.Text: Speaking of prices, if you lose against either of us, you gotta fork over three gil!

Text: いつでも　挑戦しにきてね！

English.Text: We're ready to play whenever you are!

Text: お兄さん　お金が足りないよ

English.Text: Sorry, but no gil, no game.

Text:
あっ　バウトします？
負けたら　３ギルですからね

English.Text:
You wanna play?
Remember: if you lose, you owe us three gil.

Text: 負けたら３ギルもらうからね　いい？

English.Text: If you lose, you gotta give us three gil, okay?

Text:
やるじゃん
つぎは　おれが相手だよ

English.Text: Not bad! But next, you gotta beat me.

Text: 弟のカタキは　おれがうつ！

English.Text: Don't worry, Devin! I promise I'll avenge you!

Text:
いや～　負けた負けた
お兄さん　強いね

English.Text:
Aw, I can't believe we lost!
You're better at this than I thought.

Text:
じゃあ　ぼくたち
３ギルもらえないの？

English.Text:
Hold up...
Does this mean we don't get our three gil?

Text: いや　どうだったかな～？

English.Text: No, he totally still owes us.

Text:
おれたちが負けたら
３ギルもらえるって約束だったような～

English.Text: I'm pretty sure the deal was if we lost, we got three gil. Isn't that right?

Text: あはは　冗談だって

English.Text: Uh, heheh... I'm just kidding.

Text:
今回は負けちゃったけど
つぎこそ勝って　３ギルもらうから

English.Text: You may've beaten us this time, but we'll get that three gil from you yet!

Text:
また　気が向いたら
おれたちとバウトしてよ

English.Text: So if you're ever in the mood, come back and play!

Text: よっしゃあ　まいどあり！

English.Text: Sweet! Thanks!

Text: は～い　３ギルいただきますね～

English.Text: Okay! That's three gil for us!

Text:
ちぇっ　引き分けか
お兄さん　２ギルでいいからくんない？

English.Text:
Ugh, how'd we get a tie?
Hey, maybe you could give us two gil instead?

Text: くそ～　また負けた～

English.Text: Ugh, we lost again!?

Text: お兄さん　大人なんだから手加減してよ

English.Text: Aren't grown-ups supposed to be nice and let kids win? C'mon!

Text:
この大陸のバウターたちは
あらかた倒したかな

English.Text: Pretty sure I've snuffed out all the competition there is around here.

Text:
そろそろ旅立ちの時だね
この大陸はアタシには狭すぎる

English.Text: Guess I'd better get a move on, then. No point in stickin' around if there's no one left to fight.

Text:
海がアタシを呼んでいる
いまこそ　船をこぎだす時だ

English.Text: Aye, it's past time I set sail! The sea calls to me.

Text:
対戦希望かい？
すまないが　これから海へ出るんだ

English.Text: Hm? You're not lookin' to throw down, are ya? Sorry, but I was just about to leave port.

Text:
アタシは『船乗りのイザベラ』
強者を求めて　船をこぎだすところさ

English.Text: Oh, name's Isabelle, by the way. Was lookin' for a challenge, but failed miserably.

Text:
この大陸のバウターは
どいつもこいつも　軟弱すぎるからね

English.Text: Since this place was a total bust, I figured I oughta try my luck elsewhere.

Text: でも　君はなかなか骨がありそうだ

English.Text: Although...maybe you can put up a decent fight.

Text: 面白い　景気づけに１戦交えておこうか

English.Text: Whaddya say? One round of QB before I set sail?

Text: 沈まないよう　しっかり準備するんだね

English.Text: Better batten down the hatches, 'cause I don't hold back.

Text: ガッカリさせないでくれよ

English.Text: Gimme somethin' good, will ya?

Text: 君とのバウトなら　いつでも歓迎さ

English.Text: I'll take you on as many times as you want.

Text:
そんな　このアタシが屈するなんて
これほどのバウターが　まだいたのか

English.Text: Damn, you are good. Took the wind right outta my sails. And here I was thinkin' my ship was unsinkable.

Text:
どうやらアタシは
うぬぼれてしまっていたみたいだ

English.Text: Happy to be proven wrong, though─especially by a real pro.

Text: 海に出るまえに　君と戦えてよかった

English.Text: Glad we could get that match in before I moved on.

Text:
このまま出航したところで
荒波にのまれて　沈むのがオチだったよ

English.Text: With all that pent-up frustration, I wouldn't have been able to think or sail straight!

Text: 気づかせてくれて　ありがとう

English.Text: Thanks for clearing my head.

Text:
しばらくここに留まり
いまいちど　己の甲板を磨き直すよ

English.Text: I'm gonna stick around a bit longer─just enough to swab the deck once more.

Text: この程度か　残念だな

English.Text: I was right. This place is a bust.

Text: う～ん　すこし期待しすぎたみたいだね

English.Text: ...Guess I shouldna got my hopes up.

Text: 互角か　君を倒すのは骨が折れそうだ

English.Text: I don't get draws often. You are tougher than I thought.

Text:
やはり　君とのバウトだけが
アタシに成長を感じさせてくれる

English.Text: Of all the folks I've played, you're the only one who's made me feel like I've got room to grow.

Text: 君だけだよ　アタシの期待に応えてくれるのは

English.Text: Feels good to find someone who gives me a real run for my money.

Text: ふわあ……かからんのう

English.Text: ...Not a single bite.

Text:
どこかに　活きのいいバウターは
おらんかのう

English.Text: I swear... You'd think there'd be some players in these waters!

Text:
食いついたら
いっきに釣りあげてやるのにのう

English.Text: Just one little nibble and I'd hook 'em quicker than a minnow can swim a dipper.

Text: これはこれは　面白い獲物がかかったのう

English.Text: Oh! Well, wouldja look at that. I finally hooked a catch─and a good one too!

Text: ワシのような老人なら　簡単に勝てると思ったか

English.Text: Bet you thought you could blow me out of the water just 'cause I'm getting on in years, hm?

Text: 青いな　小僧

English.Text: Well, think again.

Text: ワシは『一本釣りのゾガン』

English.Text: I'm this town's ace angler─Zogan.

Text:
活きのいいバウターを何人も
巧みにいなして　釣りあげてきたわい

English.Text: And I've caught much bigger QB fish than you, sonny, I tell you that much!

Text:
威勢だけの若造に
老練な技を見せてやろうかのう

English.Text: You young'uns can thrash all you like, but you'll never beat my years of experience.

Text: しかたない　リリースしてやろう

English.Text: Alright. Back in the water you go.

Text: さて　釣りあげるとしようかのう

English.Text: Perfect. Now, it's time to reel you in.

Text: これはまた　大物がかかったのう

English.Text: Oh, looks like I've got myself a real lunker.

Text: まさか　ワシが釣りあげ損ねるとは

English.Text: Goodness me... This makes you the one that got away!

Text: 若いと侮っていたのは　ワシのほうだったようだ

English.Text: Serves me right for looking down on you just because you're young.

Text:
釣りとカードバウトは似ておる
勝機を見極め　ここぞというところで竿をあげる

English.Text: Queen's Blood is a lot like fishing, y'know. Gotta be patient─wait for the right moment─then reel 'em in.

Text: タイミングを間違えれば　勝利は逃げてしまう

English.Text: Time it wrong, and you'll be watching your victory swim away.

Text:
逃した魚は　予想以上に大物だったか
こりゃ　惜しいことをしたわい

English.Text: Just look what happened to me! Guess I had a bigger catch on my hands than I thought. I should've been more careful!

Text: 若いバウターを釣りあげるのは　気持ちいいのう

English.Text: I tell you, hauling in a fresh youngster like yourself never gets old!

Text: くくく　狙った獲物は逃がさんよ

English.Text: Hehehe... Y'see? Nothing escapes my hook.

Text: ふむ　今回は痛み分けか

English.Text: Hmm... Guess that means we're evenly matched.

Text: 逆に釣りあげられてしまうとは　やるのう

English.Text: Never thought I'd be the one getting reeled in. Well played.

Text: この大物は　釣りあげられそうにないのう

English.Text: So you're the whopper that snaps everybody's lines, huh? Okay.

Text:
俺は流しのカードバウター
どうか　俺の叫びを聞いていってくれ

English.Text: I'm a ramblin', gamblin' fella. If you wanna hear my tale I'll tell ya.

Text: 漁師の子に生まれて２０年

English.Text: A fisherman's only child...

Text:
ある日　俺は口うるさい親父と喧嘩して
魚くさい家を飛び出した

English.Text: But pops and I didn't see eye to eye. So I packed it up, and I said "goodbye."

Text: 悪いな親父　俺には夢があるのさ！

English.Text: "Sorry, old man, but you'll never understand!

Text:
ギターとクイーンズ・ブラッド
出会っちまったものはしかたがねえ

English.Text: "With Queen's Blood and my guitar, I'm gonna be a star!

Text:
漁師なんか　まっぴらゴメンよ
目指すはゴールドソーサーのステージ

English.Text: "Fishing might pay the bills, but the Saucer's got all the thrills and all the gil!

Text: これからは　自分の腕で生きていくのさ

English.Text: "And to be frank, I wanna make bank!"

Text:
さあ　今日も音楽とバウトで
おまえらを魅了するぜ！

English.Text: So with my razzle dazzle, I'm gonna win all the card battles!

Text: なんだ　もしかしてスカウトか？

English.Text: You with an agency? Here to sign me?

Text:
歌えるバウターがいるって聞きつけて
はるばる　こんな場所まで来てくれたのか？

English.Text: No, wait─you came out here just to see the famous Queen's Blood rocker!

Text:
まあ条件次第だが　どうしてもって言うなら
デビューしてやってもいいぜ？

English.Text:
Alright, twist my arm, why don'tcha!
I'll give you the show of a lifetime!

Text: いや……

English.Text: I'm good.

Text: ガーン！

English.Text: Oof, savage!

Text:
なんだよ　スカウトじゃないのかよ
まぎらわしいな！

English.Text: So you're not a talent scout or a fan? Why didn't you say something!

Text:
俺は『流しのニール』
いつか大物になる　ギタリストバウターさ

English.Text: The name's Neil, and I'm gonna be the world's greatest QB-playin' guitarist!

Text: 俺とバウトしておくと　のちのち自慢できるぜ？

English.Text:
Whaddya say?
Wanna play against a future celebrity?

Text: 演奏だけでも　聴いていってくれよな

English.Text: You'll at least stick around to listen, right?

Text: 音楽を楽しんだら　次はバウトの時間だ！

English.Text: Nothin' like a match after a sick jam session!

Text:
いつか　俺とバウトできたことを
自慢できる日がくるぜ

English.Text: One day you'll be able to brag about playing a game with me, you'll see.

Text: ガーン！　負けちまった

English.Text: Goddamn, dude! You legit wiped the floor with me!

Text:
思えば　勝った記憶はほとんどないな
俺ってば　才能ないのかな

English.Text: Then again, I can count on one hand the times I've won. I might actually not be cut out for this.

Text: 聞こえる……

English.Text: Huh! Hear that?

Text:
敗者を奮い立たせるような激しいコード進行
メロディがおりてきた

English.Text: An upbeat melody's coming to me, clear as day. That's it─I can feel my spirits rising!

Text:
やっぱり俺は　天才ギタリストバウターだ
バウトの負けは　芸の肥やしってな

English.Text: I knew I was a musical genius. That loss was just what I needed to get my groove back!

Text: あんたのおかげで　いい曲が生まれそうだ

English.Text: Oh, I can tell this one's gonna be good.

Text:
いつかビッグになって
両親に　楽させてやりてえんだ

English.Text: One of these days I'll make it to the big time and give my folks the life they deserve.

Text:
それまで俺は
このギターとカードで　戦い続けるぜ

English.Text: Until then, there's nothing for it but to keep strumming guitar and playing cards.

Text:
まあ　あんまり落ち込むなよな
よかったら　サインしてやろうか？

English.Text: Hey, don't beat yourself up over it. Want me to sign something for you?

Text:
バウトが強くてギターもうまい
こりゃ　スカウトが来るのも時間の問題だな

English.Text: Not every day you meet a multi-hyphenate like me. Only a matter of time before I'm signed!

Text: 将来のスターと引き分けられて　良かったな

English.Text: Now you can say you tied against a budding star.

Text:
いいぞ～　負ければ負けるほど
名曲が生まれてくるぜ

English.Text: It's cool, it's cool! Losing is inspirational! I can feel the creativity flowing through me!

Text: この悔しさを　ギターに叩きつけるぜ

English.Text: Just gotta pour all this frustration into my music!

Text:
みなさん　こんにちは！
私は反神羅青年団のミザリーです

English.Text: Hello there, everyone! I'm Michaela, a member of Crows Against Shinra.

Text:
世界を平和にするために
クイーンズ・ブラッドを広める活動を
しています

English.Text: I want to tell you how we can achieve world peace through Queen's Blood!

Text: すこしお時間よろしいでしょうか！

English.Text: If you could spare just a minute.

Text:
私の知る限りクイーンズ・ブラッドほど
交渉に最適なゲームはありません

English.Text: Trust me: there's no game better for conducting negotiations than Queen's Blood!

Text:
テーブルで向かいあいカードを出しあう
これこそ　交渉ではないでしょうか！

English.Text: Because what is negotiation if not sitting down together and putting your cards on the table?

Text:
神羅の中にも
カードバウターは必ずいます

English.Text: I guarantee there are QB players within Shinra.

Text:
クイーンズ・ブラッドでなら　きっと
神羅もテーブルについてくれるはず

English.Text: So if we set up a match, I know they'd be willing to engage with us.

Text: バウトを通じて　神羅と話しあうのです

English.Text: QB is the perfect way to bridge the gap!

Text:
みなさん　まずは私と戦って
クイーンズ・ブラッドに
触れてみませんか？

English.Text: What do you say, folks? Why not brush up on your skills by playing against me first?

Text:
ぜひ　カードに想いを乗せて
神羅へ届けましょう！

English.Text: Let's show our passion through our cards, and make Shinra listen!

Text: こんにちは！

English.Text: Hello!

Text:
私は反神羅青年団所属
『クイーンズ・ブラッド推進委員のミザリー』です

English.Text: My name's Michaela, and I'm a proud member of the CAS's Queen's Blood Promotion Committee!

Text:
みなさんに　クイーンズ・ブラッドを
知ってもらうために　活動をしています

English.Text: Our goal's to spread awareness about the game's diplomatic potential!

Text:
ゆくゆくは神羅と
カードバウトを通じて交渉するつもりです

English.Text: We believe it's our best shot at getting Shinra to agree to negotiations with us.

Text: ぜひ　啓蒙活動にご協力ください！

English.Text:
Whaddya say?
Wanna play and help me drum up interest?

Text:
いつでも大歓迎なんで
気が向いたら　声をかけてくださいね！

English.Text:
You're welcome to come back anytime.
Just say the word if you wanna go a round!

Text:
いっしょに
クイーンズ・ブラッドを広めましょう！

English.Text: Let's spread the word about Queen's Blood together!

Text: カードバウトで　世界を平和にしましょう！

English.Text: A round or two would really help the cause.

Text: すばらしい！

English.Text: That was great!

Text:
テーブルで向かいあってカードを交わすことで
通じあえた気がします

English.Text: See what I'm talking about? That connection you feel when you're playing someone!

Text:
これで　あなたも同志
クイーンズ・ブラッド推進委員の一員です！

English.Text: You, my friend, are now officially a member of the Queen's Blood Promotion Committee.

Text:
私　クイーンズ・ブラッドでなら
どんな人とも　友達になれると思うんですよ

English.Text: People laugh, but I really think this game has the power to bring folks together in a way few things can.

Text:
世界を平和に導くには
武力ではなく　遊びが必要なんです

English.Text: 'Cause the key to world peace isn't violence. It's joy. Plain and simple joy.

Text:
同志よ　世界中でバウトをして
この楽しい遊びを広めてくれたまえ！

English.Text: Comrade! I hereby ask you to go forth and play Queen's Blood─spread the joy of gaming!

Text: よろしく頼んだぞ！

English.Text: I'm counting on you!

Text: 勝っても負けても　バウトをすれば友達です！

English.Text: Win or lose, you still stand to gain a good friend.

Text: カードを通じて　たくさんお話できましたね

English.Text: It's almost like our cards were speaking for us, right?

Text: ふう　白熱のバウトでしたね

English.Text: Whew... Now that was an intense game.

Text: さすがは同志　ナイスバウトです

English.Text: Nice one. I knew you'd give me a good match.

Text:
ぐぬぬ……
同志とはいえ　負けると悔しいです

English.Text: Damn... Losing's still rough, even if it is to a fellow freedom fighter.

Text: クラウドさん……クラウドさん！

English.Text: Cloud...? Cloud...!

Text: よかった　繋がった！

English.Text: Oh, thank goodness! I was so worried!

Text: いまのは？

English.Text: What just...?

Text:
一瞬ではありますが
位置情報が完全にロストして

English.Text: I was unable to locate you, albeit for only a moment.

Text:
クラウドさんになにかあったのではと
ボク……

English.Text: If something had happened to you because of me, I...

Text: 大丈夫だ　問題はない

English.Text: Nothing happened. I'm fine.

Text: すみません　取り乱してしまって

English.Text: Right─my apologies. I let my emotions get the better of me.

Text:
ははっ　なんだ
案外可愛らしいとこもあんじゃねえか

English.Text: Rattled ya, huh? Could it be ya got a soft spot for SOLDIER boy here?

Text:
バレットさんのからかいに
ボク自身の苛立ちを検知

English.Text: Annoyance response triggered. Cause: Barret's mocking tone of voice.

Text:
なにかあっても　自力で対処する
俺の心配はいらない

English.Text: Anyway, don't worry about it. Been in much worse situations than that before.

Text: はい……

English.Text: Very well...

Text:
今後は　あらためてセキュリティを強化しつつ
探索に臨みましょう！

English.Text: Regardless, I will do what I can to improve security measures.

Text: 子供たちを連れ戻してくれて　助かったクポ！

English.Text: I really can't thank you enough for bringing all the mooglets back!

Text:
モーグリ・モグとマグが
いっしょに作ったお店を潰さずにすんだクポ

English.Text: It's such a relief the emporium that Mog and Mag built together won't have to close down.

Text: ありがとうクポ～

English.Text: You're a lifesaver, kupo!

Text:
クラウドさん
ジュノンエリアの調査は　これにて完了です！

English.Text: Cloud! You've completed our survey of the Junon region, I see.

Text:
潮風をあびつづけた歴史ある土地を調べることで
ジュノン共和国について理解が深まりました

English.Text: I've learned so much about the Republic of Junon, thanks in no small part to your efforts in these storied lands.

Text:
世界を掌握した大国の研究は
神羅の行く末を見通すためにも重要だと思います

English.Text: Such insight into our past will invariably help us understand the course Shinra may take in the future.

Text: 貴重なデータの提供　ありがとうございました

English.Text: I cannot thank you enough for partnering with me.

Text:
クラウドさん
コレルエリアの調査は　これにて完了です！

English.Text: That was excellent work in completing our survey of the Corel region, Cloud!

Text:
炎の中から蘇ったと伝わるジュノンの霊鳥
『フェニックス』を仮想空間に再現しました！

English.Text: I have recreated Phoenix, the firebird of reincarnation from Junon legend, within the simulator.

Text:
召喚マテリアを生成するためにも
ぜひ　バトルデータの収集にご協力ください

English.Text: I encourage you to pit your skills against this summoned entity, so that I might complete its materia.

Text: クラウドさん

English.Text: Cloud!

Text: ジュノンのチョコボファームへようこそ

English.Text: Junon's chocobo ranch.

Text: クラウドさん　ご存知ですか？

English.Text: Perhaps you were already aware...

Text:
ここではチョコボのエサに
海藻や魚の骨の粉末を混ぜているそうです

English.Text: but the chocobos here are raised on a diet of feed, seaweed, and fish bone meal.

Text: 魚介がとれる街ならではですね

English.Text: Unsurprising, given the local industry.

Text: ジュノンのチョコボは捕まえましたか？

English.Text: I suspect you've already noticed...

Text:
このあたりのチョコボは　厳しい潮風に
鍛えられたのか　足腰が発達しているようです

English.Text: but the chocobos here have especially muscular legs, allowing them to scale steep inclines with ease.

Text:
ここのチョコボなら
崖なんかも登れるかもしれません

English.Text: An adaptation for traversing Junon's rugged terrain.

Text: このあたりは　興味深い地形をしていますね

English.Text: The topography here piques my interest.

Text:
船で運んできた荷物を　深い入江を利用して
内陸まで届けていたようです

English.Text: The inlets serve as natural harbors for ships of all sizes to take on and deliver cargo.

Text:
なるほど
ジュノンが船で栄えていた理由がわかりました

English.Text: Which is why the republic relied so heavily on maritime trade.

Text:
昔は　このあたりに
造船所がたくさんあったのですが

English.Text: Many years ago, shipyards dotted the Junon coastline.

Text:
神羅が造船業を取り仕切るようになって
すべて潰れてしまったそうです

English.Text: Following the war, though, Shinra allowed these yards to fall into disrepair.

Text:
廃船や工場跡を眺めていると
なんだか　さびしい気持ちになりますね

English.Text: Today, the abandoned facilities and scrapped vessels are monuments to the republic Shinra destroyed.

Text:
クラウドさんも
アンダージュノンにいらっしゃったんですね

English.Text: I see that you've made your way to Under Junon!

Text:
ここは　どこかミッドガルのスラムを思わせますね
どちらも頭上を覆われているからでしょうか

English.Text: This town is quite reminiscent of the Midgar undercity, isn't it? The severe lack of sunlight being one similarity.

Text: クラウドさん　海には行かれました？

English.Text: Cloud, have you been down to the beach yet?

Text:
ここの海には　かつて
共和国の首都があったんですよ

English.Text: From there, you can see where the republic's capital once was.

Text:
大型船を繋ぎあわせた
海上都市だったと言います

English.Text: It was a flotilla─a thriving city built across ships.

Text:
この目で見てみたかったのですが
残念ながら　戦争で沈んでしまいました

English.Text: Alas, the capital now sleeps at the bottom of the ocean─having been sunk in the war.

Text:
この街の海が変色しているのに
気がつかれましたか？

English.Text: Have you noticed the unique coloration of the coastal waters?

Text: どうやら　魔晄ガスが溶け込んでいるようです

English.Text: It would seem that mako pollution is to blame.

Text:
海底魔晄炉を持つ　ジュノン特有の公害なのですが
神羅は見て見ぬフリをしています

English.Text: The underwater reactor and its waste products pose a dire threat to both the people and the environment.

Text: なにか　対策が見つかるといいのですが

English.Text: Not that Shinra would ever admit to such a thing.

Text: クラウドさん　お食事はとられましたか？

English.Text: Have you had a chance to sample the local cuisine, Cloud?

Text:
アンダージュノンは　魚を干したものや
伝統的な方法で発酵させたものが有名ですよ

English.Text: Under Junon is well known for not only its sun-dried fish, but also its fermented foodstuffs.

Text:
ボクも食べてみたのですが
なんともいえない　非常に独特なかおりがしました

English.Text: I was so curious that I ordered some myself, and found that it...had a very "unique" taste.

Text: 機会があったら　ぜひ挑戦してみてください

English.Text: But don't take my word for it─try some.

Text: えっと　なにかご用でしょうか？

English.Text:
Good day.
Is there something I can help you with?

Text: スキャンを実行……該当者あり

English.Text:
Scanning...
Potential research candidate confirmed.

Text:
えっ　クラウドさん？
その格好　どうされたんですか

English.Text:
Cloud!?
Why in the world are you wearing that uniform?

Text:
いや　やっぱり聞かないでおきます
きっと　秘密の潜入作戦なんですよね

English.Text: On second thought, forget I asked. The less I know about your undercover pursuits, the better.

Text: フェニックスの討伐　お見事でした！

English.Text: That was a masterful victory over Phoenix!

Text:
不死鳥が操る幻想的な炎に
思わず見とれてしまいました

English.Text: The flames it conjured were so captivating... I could hardly look away!

Text:
転生を繰り返す霊鳥を仲間に加えて
もはや怖いものナシですね！

English.Text: With an immortal ally like that at your side, you've nothing to fear─not even death!

Text:
クラウドさん　山チョコボなら
この崖も登れるはずです

English.Text: This cliff appears to be insurmountable without a mountain chocobo.

Text: クラウドさん

English.Text: Cloud.

Text:
この先に進むには
山チョコボの強靭な足腰が必要ですね

English.Text: If you wish to proceed any further, you'll need a hearty mountain chocobo.

Text: クラウドさん

English.Text: Cloud!

Text:
データを分析した結果　ジュノンに潜む怪人
『マインドフレア』が見つかりました

English.Text: Your combat data has revealed the location of the mindflayer lurking in the Junon region.

Text:
この恐ろしい怪人は
人間の脳を吸い取ると言われています

English.Text: It's said this eldritch horror devours the brains of its victims.

Text: 一刻も早く　討伐をお願いします！

English.Text: We cannot turn a blind eye to this threat!

Text:
クラウドさん　マインドフレア討伐
おめでとうございます！

English.Text: Cloud! Congratulations on dispatching the mindflayer!

Text:
クラウドさんの頭脳が吸い取られるのではないかと
ドキドキしていましたが　杞憂でしたね

English.Text: I was concerned the fiend might feast upon your brains, but I'm glad to see my fears were unfounded.

Text:
怪人を撃破したクラウド様は
まさに正義のヒーロー！

English.Text: Only a true hero could ever have defeated such a malevolent evil.

Text:
これで　世界がまたすこし平和になりました
ありがとう　ヒーロー！

English.Text: Your valiant efforts today have brought the world one step closer to peace!

Text: ありがとう　ヒーロー！

English.Text: Thank you, hero!

Text:
クラウドさん
ライフストリームを調べたところ

English.Text: Cloud! By analyzing the lifespring data...

Text:
共和国時代のクラフトチップが
埋まっている場所がわかりました

English.Text: I was able to locate an old republic transmuter chip.

Text:
海沿いにある　ジュノン共和国時代の残骸とともに
眠っているようです

English.Text: It can be found within a derelict structure that sits upon the coastline.

Text:
このあたりは　戦争中に激しい砲撃を受けたらしく
クレーターがいくつも残っています

English.Text: This area is mottled with craters resulting from intense warfare between the republic and Shinra.

Text: 足元に気をつけて進んでくださいね

English.Text: Do mind your step as you proceed.

Text:
クラウドさん　お疲れ様でした
今回のバトルはいかがでしたか？

English.Text: Most excellent work, Cloud. Did that battle prove a fitting test of your prowess?

Text: ふふふ　『物足りなかった』という不満を検知

English.Text: Your dissatisfied expression says it all.

Text: わたくしも検知　検知しました！

English.Text: Oh yes, I noticed that as well!

Text: ＭＡＩに　そんな機能はついてません

English.Text: You aren't equipped with that functionality.

Text:
クラウドさん　今回の戦闘データを使って
新たなコンバットコースを作成しました

English.Text: Anyway, with the data from your latest bout, I created a new virtual combat trial.

Text: よかったら　挑戦してみてください

English.Text: It will prove a real test!

Text:
クラウド様　ジュノンの討伐依頼は
今回でコンプリートです！

English.Text: Nice! You've successfully completed all Junon combat assignments.

Text:
あらあら　どうされました？
すこし　お疲れの様子ですね

English.Text: Oh, is something the matter? Perhaps you're fatigued from your battles?

Text: わたくしが　肩でももみましょうか？

English.Text: Then allow me to provide a massage!

Text: どうやってやるつもりですか

English.Text: And how do you plan to do that?

Text:
わたくしには　この美声があります
ほら　こんなふうにバイブレーションでぇ～

English.Text: Why, by way of resonance, of course! I can use my gorgeous vocal vibrations! Ahem! Like sooo!

Text: あははは……冗談はこれぐらいにして

English.Text: Hahaha. Alright, MAI. You've had your fun.

Text:
今回も新たなコンバットコースを作成しましたので
そのうち　チャレンジしてみてください

English.Text: Now then, your latest triumph has allowed me to create a new combat trial. I hope you enjoy it.

Text:
ジュノンには
召喚獣『フェニックス』の祠があります

English.Text: Junon is home to the summoned entity Phoenix.

Text:
炎の召喚獣と言えばイフリートが有名ですが
フェニックスも負けていません

English.Text: Though Ifrit is often associated with fire, Phoenix's flames are no less potent.

Text:
イフリートの敵を焼き尽くす炎と違い
フェニックスの炎は　生み出す炎と言われています

English.Text: In fact, the conflagrations of this undying bird are said to imbue those it touches with renewed life.

Text: きっと　優しい炎なんでしょうね

English.Text: Perhaps it will offer you its grace.

Text: ジュノンには　こんな伝説が残っています

English.Text: Many legends about Phoenix have been passed down.

Text:
ある日　寿命を迎えようとしていたフェニックスが
ジュノンの海岸に降り立ったところ

English.Text: One tells of the great bird scouring the coast in search of a final resting place.

Text: そこにちょうど　焚火にあたっていた漁師がいて

English.Text: A fisherman bade it share the warmth of his fire.

Text:
フェニックスは　その焚火を分けてもらうと
炎に身を包み　見事に復活したそうです

English.Text: Phoenix dipped its feathers in the proffered flames, thereby rekindling its fading life force.

Text:
このあたりに残る伝説によると
ジュノンで復活したフェニックスは

English.Text: The legend also tells of the gifts Phoenix bestowed on the kind angler.

Text:
お礼とばかりに　炎から様々な魚を生み出して
海へと放ったと言います

English.Text: As thanks for his fire, the great bird brought forth myriad fish into the world.

Text:
クラウドさん　ジュノンでお魚を食べる時は
フェニックスに感謝してくださいね

English.Text: So when next you partake of the region's seafood, remember to praise Phoenix!

Text:
これで　ジュノンにあるクリスタルは
すべて解析できました　お疲れ様です

English.Text: Well done! You've located and analyzed all the crystals in the Junon region.

Text:
フェニックスが
さらに美しくなるかもしれませんね　楽しみです

English.Text: Thanks to you, Phoenix's flames will no doubt be that much more radiant!

Text:
でも　クラウドさんは
まだ召喚マテリアをお持ちじゃなかったですね

English.Text: Though you have yet to obtain the requisite materia, as I recall.

Text:
まずは　バトルシミュレーターで
召喚獣に挑戦してみてください！

English.Text: You'll first need to confront the divine via the combat simulator!

Text:
おめでとうございます
ランクが『戦血の平民』になりましたね

English.Text:
Congratulations, Cloud.
You have attained the rank of Blood Squire.

Text:
そんなクラウドさんに
バウター情報をお伝えします

English.Text: As such, I have information that may be of interest.

Text:
サイドジュノンに『さすらいのカマロ』と呼ばれる
やり手のバウターが滞在しているようです

English.Text: A talented player by the name of Cameron is looking for opponents within the Crow's Nest.

Text:
いまのクラウドさんなら
いい腕試しになると思います

English.Text:
I believe that you would find
him to be a suitable challenge.

Text:
おめでとうございます
ランクが『戦血の騎士』になりましたね

English.Text:
Congratulations, Cloud.
You have attained the rank of Blood Knight.

Text:
クラウドさん
新たなバウター情報を入手しました

English.Text: And I have obtained intel on a new opponent for you.

Text:
北コレルに『百目のナバラ』と呼ばれる
摩訶不思議なバウターがいるそうです

English.Text: There is a somewhat mysterious player by the name of Navalan in North Corel.

Text:
クラウド様
マインドフレアの生息地に到着しました

English.Text: Beware, Cloud. You've entered the mindflayer's natural habitat.

Text:
相手は　得体の知れない怪人です
しっかり準備を整えて挑みましょう！

English.Text: There's still much we don't know about this creature, so make sure you're well prepared before proceeding!

Text: マインドフレアの出現を確認しました

English.Text: Mindflayer detected in the vicinity.

Text: これより　ガイドを開始します

English.Text: Commencing guidance protocol.

Text: マインドフレア発生の経緯には諸説あり

English.Text: There are several theories as to the mindflayer's origin.

Text:
一説によれば　かつて
ひとりの賢者が知識を求めるあまりに
モンスターの脳をむさぼり続けた結果
あのような姿になったのだとか

English.Text: One posits that it's the mutated form of a scholar who devoured fiends' brains as part of an experiment. He supposedly ate so many, he became a fiend himself.

Text:
マインドフレアは　念力と魔力で
ジワジワと獲物を追い詰めたあと
じっくりと　その脳を味わうそうです

English.Text: The mindflayer's affinity for magic─and its preference for consuming the brains of its victims─lends some credence to this assertion.

Text: うう　回路がゾワゾワします！

English.Text: ...It's enough to fry your circuits!

Text:
わたくしの優秀な回路と
ジュノンの地に平穏を取り戻すためにも
怪人退治をお願いします！

English.Text: Please, eliminate this fiend at once! Not only for the sake of the Junon region, but for this poor AI's peace of mind!

Text: トーンアドゥの希少種を確認しました

English.Text: Rare tonadu variant identified.

Text: これより　ガイドを開始します

English.Text: Commencing guidance protocol.

Text:
トーンアドゥは　この季節になると
繁殖のためジュノンの地に渡ってきます

English.Text: During this time of year, tonadus migrate to the Junon region to seek out mates.

Text:
人里から離れた場所に巣を作り
つがいで子育てをしますが
外に出てエサを探すのは
オスの仕事なのだとか

English.Text: They build their nests far from civilization and raise their young in pairs. In terms of duties, it often falls to the males to search for food.

Text:
可愛い我が子へ食料を届けようと
時には市街地にまで姿を現し
人間を襲うこともあるようです

English.Text: Unfortunately, when food is scarce, they may occasionally venture into towns and cities, where they have been known to attack humans.

Text:
神羅のジュノン建設によって
自然が失われたせいなのでしょうが
放っておくわけにもいきません

English.Text: As Shinra's activities continue to disrupt the ecosystem, such attacks will only grow more frequent.

Text:
ヒナへの手土産にされないよう
気をつけつつ　調査を進めてください！

English.Text: On that note, please take care not to become a snack during your investigation.

Text: ゼムゼレットの希少種を確認しました

English.Text: Rare zemzelett variant identified.

Text: これより　ガイドを開始します

English.Text: Commencing guidance protocol.

Text:
ゼムゼレットは『風の賢者』とも呼ばれ
知能が非常に高く
発達した羽で風を乗りこなしながら
巧みに獲物を追い込んで仕留めます

English.Text: Zemzeletts are known as the "sages of the skies," not only because of their intelligence, but also their remarkable feathers that make them both elegant and lethal.

Text:
あの美しい羽は強度も兼ね備えており
昔から　様々な形で活用されてきました

English.Text: These feathers have been prized by all manner of craftsmen since antiquity for their beauty and resilience.

Text:
特に　希少種の羽を用いた矢は
風を切り裂き巨石を貫くとも言われ
大変な値打ちがあったそうですよ

English.Text: Arrows fashioned from them are particularly valuable. They're said to slice through the air so quickly, they're capable of piercing even solid stone.

Text:
美しい羽に見とれて
仕留められてしまわないように
お気をつけください！

English.Text: Oh, but take care not to be so entranced by their abilities that you lose focus!

Text: ネロスフェロスの希少種を確認しました

English.Text: Rare ignilisk variant identified.

Text: これより　ガイドを開始します

English.Text: Commencing guidance protocol.

Text:
大型モンスターに捕食されることが多く
警戒心の強いネロスフェロスは

English.Text: As their size puts them at the lower end of the food chain, they're exceptionally skittish creatures.

Text:
独自の体温調節器官を持っており
放熱の力を利用して
果敢に外敵から身を守っています

English.Text: In addition, they can actively regulate their body temperature, thus allowing them to emit heat as a defense against predators.

Text:
そんな　命を懸けたアタックは
異性へのアピールでもあるのだとか

English.Text: There are theories that these fiery displays may also be employed in mating rituals.

Text:
強い個体ほどモテるのは
自然界の摂理なのでしょうか

English.Text: After all, nature is said to be a "survival of the fittest."

Text:
ネロスフェロスの熱量に負けないよう
我々も情熱的に
調査を進めていきましょう

English.Text: May we too pursue our objective with a passion that burns as bright as the ignilisk's scales.

Text: フォーミュラの希少種を確認しました

English.Text: Rare fleetwing variant identified.

Text: これより　ガイドを開始します

English.Text: Commencing guidance protocol.

Text:
フォーミュラは別名
『空駆けるハンター』とも呼ばれ

English.Text: Fleetwings are also known as "stalkers of the skies."

Text:
上空から急降下することで
獲物に反撃の隙を与えず
狡猾に狩りを行います

English.Text: When hunting, they descend so rapidly that their unsuspecting prey has no time to react, let alone fight back.

Text:
もし　フォーミュラのなわばりで
バーベキューなどしようものなら
焼いているそばから
肉という肉が消え失せてしまいますよ

English.Text: To that end, barbecuing within their territory is not advisable...unless you want your food to vanish before your very eyes.

Text:
また　スピードに特化するため
独自の進化を遂げた機能的な羽は
現代の航空工学にも応用されています

English.Text: As it happens, fleetwings are so perfectly adapted to life in the skies that their anatomy has inspired several aeronautical designs.

Text:
フォーミュラの研究が進めば
人類は　もっともっと自由自在に
空を駆けることができるはずです

English.Text: Continued research into this aerodynamic wonder will surely pave the way for humanity's flight-filled future.

Text:
ユー・キャン・フライです
クラウド様！

English.Text: You'll be soaring through the clouds before you know it!
